Base directory for this skill: /Users/farhanriuzaki/.claude/plugins/cache/mega-sdd/mega-sdd/7.34.0/skills/resolve-oq

# Resolve Open Questions

Interactive resolver for Open Questions in a vault generated by `generate-intent`. Walks the OQ roll-up by priority (P1 → P2 → P3), captures stakeholder answers, marks resolved entries inline, and bumps the vault version + Changelog. A second mode (`--binding`) walks CONFLICT entries from a `bind-codebase` output.

> **Skill instruction language:** this skill reasons in English. Resolution content (answers captured from the user) is recorded in the vault's existing language — same as the rest of the vault.

## When to use

Trigger when the user has a `generate-intent` vault and wants to walk the Open Questions list interactively: "resolve open questions", "answer the OQs", "walk through OQ list", "jawab OQ list", "tackle the P1 blockers", or after a stakeholder meeting that produced answers to bring back into the vault.

Do NOT use when: the vault hasn't been generated yet (use `generate-intent` first); or the user wants ad-hoc Q&A about the vault (use a read-doc style query, or just chat with the vault loaded as context).

## Core principle

> **Resolutions live where they belong, but the OQ tag history is preserved.**

Every Open Question carries a stable identifier (`OQ-{CODE}-{N}`) that tracks the gap from raw PRD through resolution. When an OQ is resolved: (1) the resolution content is captured in the vault; (2) the OQ entry stays in its original Open Questions section, marked `[x]` resolved with a pointer to where the answer landed (or the answer inlined for simple cases); (3) the vault version bumps and the Changelog records which OQs were resolved this round. This preserves auditability — anyone can trace each OQ tag from its PRD-gap origin to its final resolution.

## Resolution outcomes

For each OQ the user (with the skill prompting) chooses one of four outcomes. The skill never auto-decides — it captures stakeholder answers. **All four are collected in ONE `AskUserQuestion` per OQ** (shape + slots: `references/interactive-walk.md` Step 2b, which is canonical). The `action` letters below are the recorded derive contract — they are NOT the display slot numbers.

| Outcome | Prompt slot | `action` | Effect on vault | OQ marker | vault.json `status` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Resolve** | `[1]` recommended / **Other** (free text, or a bare `→ <file>.md` that accepts the recommendation and re-lands it) | `A` | Capture answer; inline in OQ entry (simple) or promoted into a target section — new ADR, field constraint, flow step. The answer option's description DISCLOSES where it lands, so choosing it also confirms the destination. | `[x]` + `→ Resolved v{X.Y}: <answer / pointer>` | `resolved` |
| **Skip** | `[2]` | `D` (no derive run) | No vault change; revisited on the next pass. **The walk continues** to the next OQ. | unchanged | unchanged (remains `open`) |
| **Defer** (to binding / stakeholder) | `[3]` | `B` | Keep open with stakeholder, deadline, or condition; or mark code-aware for `bind-codebase`. Costs ONE follow-up CALL carrying TWO questions (sub-target + reason) — recorded state, never invented. | `[ ]` + `**Deferred (v{X.Y})**: <reason / who / when>` | `deferred` |
| **Out of Scope** | `[4]` | `C` | Move to the doc's Out of Scope section with rationale. Costs ONE follow-up prompt (the rationale). | `[~]` + `→ Out of Scope v{X.Y}: <reason>` | `out_of_scope` |
| *(end the walk)* | **Esc** | — (no derive run) | This OQ untouched; jump to Step 3 — version bump + Changelog still record the round, then exit. | unchanged | unchanged (remains `open`) |

The platform caps `AskUserQuestion` at 4 options **per question**, so **"Other" carries the free-text answer** (that merge is the collapse) and the considered alternatives ride the question text as prose instead of a slot. **Esc ends the WALK** — the same meaning the plugin's two other `AskUserQuestion` surfaces give it (`execute-bolts/references/halt-recovery.md`, `execute-bolts/references/propose-and-confirm-prompt.md`), so Skip gets a real slot. **There is no typed `STOP` sentinel**: an OQ like "lanjut atau berhenti?" is answerable with the word "stop", which a sentinel would silently swallow. Skip and Esc are both stated in the question text of every prompt, so neither is folklore.

The 4-option cap is **per question, not per call** — one `AskUserQuestion` takes 1–4 questions, each with its own ≤4 options and its own "Other". That is why the Defer follow-up collects both the sub-target and the reason in ONE round trip.

`Defer` (slot `[3]`) is ALWAYS visible in the standard walk (stakeholder defer must be reachable in every context — the "No invention" rule routes `idk`/`whatever` here; the `--binding` propagated-OQ walk drops the slot per `references/binding-mode.md` — nested deferral not supported). Its `to binding` sub-target is offered as Q1 of the Defer follow-up ONLY when vault `mode: existing` (brownfield) AND CWD has repo signals (`.git`, `package.json`, `composer.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `pyproject.toml`); greenfield / no signals → the follow-up carries the reason question alone and `defer_to` is written EXPLICITLY as `stakeholder` by the derive patch — not a schema default (`vault-core.md` declares none for `defer_to`), but the only LEGAL value there, since `binding` means "resolved at `bind-codebase`" and greenfield has no repo to bind against. Because Q1 vanishes in greenfield, **Q2 carries the OQ tag + verbatim question text in its own body** — a bare "alasan defer-nya apa?" would breach keterangan rule 1.

## Workflow (compact)

Echo `VAULT_DIR=<resolved-absolute-path>` after Step 0 and re-echo at the start of each major step. Full per-step procedure, display formats, templates, and the self-check list are in **`references/interactive-walk.md`** — load it before running the walk.

**Step 0 — Vault location & integrity (MANDATORY).** Get the vault path (`AskUserQuestion`: use auto-detected / specify / cancel). Auto-detect = the CWD directory containing `vault.md` (layout-2) or the legacy `00-index.md` set. **No vault found but a KB is (7.21.0):** probe the KB paths in `generate-intent/references/kb-submode.md §KB auto-detection` priority order (`.mega-sdd/knowledge-base/README.md` → `docs/knowledge-base/` → `docs/mega-sdd/knowledge-base/` → `old-reference/knowledge-base/`) — a hit offers **KB mode** via AskUserQuestion (keterangan: OQ §6 PRD-kontrak dijawab langsung di KB; jawaban ikut ke vault nanti saat `generate-intent --kb`); accept → §KB mode below. A vault always wins when both exist; KB is the fallback only. Verify integrity: the layout's files exist (4 or 7); the authored OQ surface exists (`constraints.md ## Open Questions`; legacy: the 00-index roll-up); ≥1 `[ ]` OQ exists. Any failure → **STOP**, surface the issue, suggest `generate-intent`. **Lock check:** parse the lock home (vault.md frontmatter; legacy: `00-index.md` Vault Lock Status) — if `🔒 LOCKED`, ask to unlock (record unlock in this round's Changelog; user re-locks after); if `⚠️ DRAFT`, continue. Never proceed without a verified vault and lock-state acknowledged.

**Step 0.5 — Resume detection (MANDATORY).** Parse the vault Changelog (`vault.md ## Changelog`; legacy: `00-index.md`) for prior `resolve-oq` rounds. If found → show current version + last-round stats, ask continue / fresh / cancel. If none → first pass.

**Step 0.6 — Resolution scope (MANDATORY).**
- Ask which OQs to walk: `all-priorities` (**recommended — ONE walk, P1→P2→P3 in order so the blocking tier is still resolved first; avoids re-entering and re-reading the whole vault for a separate P2 pass**) | `p1-only` (unblock-the-chain-fast — only when you will defer P2/P3 to a later session) | `p1-then-p2` | `by-category` | `single-oq <tag>`. Persist `RESOLUTION_SCOPE`; echo it back.
- **The walk stays interactive on EVERY OQ regardless of scope** — `all-priorities` does NOT auto-resolve P1 (the no-fabrication rule in "Hard rules" still holds; collapsing the passes only saves the second vault read, never the stakeholder input).
- **Express chain exception (P3 — the ONLY path where scope is not asked):** when this skill is CHAIN-ROUTED via the oq_gate under the express spine + `--auto`, Step 0.6 resolves deterministically to `express-batched`: the BLOCKING tier (P1 — the repo's "Sprint-0 blocker", the v6 prose's "P0") is asked in batched AskUserQuestion calls (up to 4 OQs per call, each question keeping the full 4-slot + Other shape and the keterangan contract; >4 open P1s chunk into ceil(N/4) sequential calls, disclosed upfront: "N blocker, K prompt"). **W1 zero-idle (v8 P1.e, spec App. F6a):** the SAME batched call carries, as its last question, the **L0 toolchain decision** whenever `.mega-sdd/.l0-toolchain-probe.json` has `advisory: true` and `.mega-sdd/l0-toolchain-decision.json` is absent — options identical to execute-bolts pre-flight 3.8 (pasang linter dulu / `## Toolchain` di pack proyek / N/A tercatat); write `.mega-sdd/l0-toolchain-decision.json` `{"decision":"linter-planned|pack-toolchain|na","by":"user","written_at":"<ISO8601>"}` so 3.8 stays silent later. An answer of Defer or Out of scope on this path RECORDS its sub-fields from the same answer — `defer_to` = the rule-4b default (`stakeholder` greenfield / `binding` brownfield), reason = the Other/free-text of that answer or the mechanical auto-defer string — with **no second `AskUserQuestion`** (the Step 2c follow-ups in `references/interactive-walk.md` are the standalone-walk path only). Zero P1 blockers and no L0 item ⇒ no call at all.
- The DEFER tier (P2/P3) is AUTO-DEFERRED on the record — the shipped Defer plumbing verbatim (`[ ]` + `**Deferred (v{X.Y})**` marker, `status: deferred`, `defer_to: stakeholder`, script-stamped `deferred_at`) with the mechanical reason `auto-deferred (P<n>, express) — bukan blocker delivery pertama; muncul lagi di delivery report`; per OQ, one derive run carrying BOTH the `--event '{"event":"oq-deferred",…,"action":"B"}'` AND the stakeholder `--patch` file `{"open_questions":{"OQ-XXX":{"defer_to":"stakeholder"}}}` — `defer_to` is patch-lane-only (the deriver never parses it from markdown), so an event alone records an INCOMPLETE defer.
- NEVER silent: the walk summary + the handoff `metrics.items_deferred` id list + the delivery-report surfaces re-surface every auto-deferred tag. A standalone/explicit invocation (any spine) and every classic-spine invocation keep the fully interactive walk — auto-defer NEVER applies there.

**Step 1 — Parse OQ list.** Layout-2: read `constraints.md ## Open Questions` (every OQ lives there; `[origin: <file>#<anchor>]` is the locality). Legacy: read the 7 files' per-doc OQ sections + cross-reference the 00-index roll-up for **category** (layout-2 category = the mandatory bracket). Extract still-`[ ]` entries (skip `[x]` / `[~]`); per OQ capture tag, priority, origin, question text, generator resolution hint. Build the work queue per `RESOLUTION_SCOPE`. Empty queue → skip to Step 5 with summary.

**Step 2 — Loop per OQ.**
- Display the OQ **human-framed first (7.21.1, extended 7.22.0)**: `Konteks` (situasi bisnis + posisi di alur) → `Yang udah ketahuan` / `Yang belum` (fakta kode vs gap) → `Kenapa penting` (P-level sebagai dampak) → `Contoh` (satu skenario NETRAL, hanya bila derivable) → `Maksudnya` (yang diminta dari user), THEN the technical detail block (doc → section, verbatim question text, hint) — the framing is a display translation, never a rewrite of the stored text, derives only from the OQ + citations (no invented facts), and stays ≤ ~7 lines (dataless slots are skipped, never padded). Prepend scope context when `vault.json` has `scope`. Shape + rails (incl. example neutrality): `references/interactive-walk.md` Step 2a.
- Present **ONE `AskUserQuestion`** — 4 slots (`[1]` recommended answer, `[2]` Skip, `[3]` Defer, `[4]` Out of scope) + "Other" (the free-text answer + destination override, whose `→ <file>.md` target is VALIDATED pre-write against the vault's 7 document filenames — a miss is not an override, is narrated, and never lands an answer outside those seven) + Esc (end the walk).
- The considered alternatives are listed as prose in the question text, each with its source or an explicit `tanpa sumber` marker — never invented.
- The answer option's description carries its keterangan AND discloses where the answer lands (target doc, inline vs promoted, cross-cutting cross-refs), so the choice IS the destination confirmation — **do NOT ask for the answer or the destination in separate prompts.** Only Defer and Out of scope spend a second prompt (Defer = ONE call carrying two questions, sub-target + reason; OOS = the rationale).
- Apply the chosen outcome's markdown edits, then run the derive script immediately (it recomputes the vault.json mirror from the markdown and appends the round event).
- Resolve density = **inline** (short) or **promoted** (substantial → new ADR / constraint / flow step, OQ points to it). Legacy vaults only: update the 00-index roll-up to mirror the marker (layout-2 has no roll-up).
- Bail-out is reachable on every prompt via Esc; each derive is atomic, so a bail leaves the last consistent state.
- **The prompt's verbatim shape, the no-recommendation shape, the "Other" parse order, the Defer/OOS follow-up templates, all outcomes' markdown edits, the per-action `--event`/`--patch` args, and promoted-entry formatting per target doc are in `references/interactive-walk.md`.**

**Step 3 — Update vault metadata.** Patch-bump the vault version in the lock home (vault.md frontmatter `vault_version:`; legacy: `00-index.md` Vault Lock Status) — one shared `v{X.Y}` for the whole round. Append a Changelog entry listing Resolved / Out of Scope / Deferred / Still-open counts (template in `references/interactive-walk.md`). Update `Last updated` to today.

**Step 4 — Self-check before exit.** Every resolved OQ `[x]` with a `→ Resolved v{X.Y}` pointer in BOTH origin doc and roll-up; every OOS `[~]` present in the target Out of Scope section; every Deferred `[ ]` with a defer note; no OQ silently dropped; version bumped; Changelog accurate; `Last updated` set; promoted entries exist (grep the cross-reference); no invented answers; `vault.json` summary + per-OQ `status` match the markdown. Full checklist in `references/interactive-walk.md`.

**Step 5 — Present summary.** Stats (`{R} resolved · {O} OOS · {D} deferred · {S} skipped · {N} unreached (Esc ended the walk before them — name the resume tag) · {U} untouched`); new `v{X.Y}`; absolute `VAULT_DIR`; top 3 remaining P1 blockers if any; next step (re-run after stakeholder follow-up; lock manually for sprint). If any OQs deferred to binding → suggest `scan-codebase && bind-codebase` (brownfield) or warn there is no resolution path (greenfield). No "I have resolved…" preamble.

## KB mode (7.21.0 — spec 2026-09-02-kb-oq-resolution-and-human-language.md)

Entered ONLY from Step 0's no-vault-but-KB offer. Walks the `## 6. Open Questions` section of every `<kb>/modules/*.prd.md` — the tag convention (`OQ-<DOMAIN>-<NN> [P1|P2|P3]`) is already vault-identical, and the per-OQ prompt keeps the canonical shape (4 slots + Other + Esc, keterangan rules, no-invention). Differences vs the vault walk, exhaustive:

- **NO derive-vault-json run** — the KB has no `vault.json`; the §6 markdown is the only state. No lock check, no vault version bump. The round is recorded by appending ONE line to `<kb>/README.md` under `## Resolution rounds` (create the section when absent): `- <YYYY-MM-DD>: {R} resolved · {O} OOS · {D} deferred · {S} skipped`.
- **Landing per outcome:** Resolve → `[x] → Resolved (stakeholder, <YYYY-MM-DD>): <answer>` · Defer → `[ ]` + `**Deferred**: <reason>` · Out of scope → `[~] → Out of scope: <reason>`.
- **Honesty rail:** the claim row in its home §-table STAYS `[OPEN]` — the resolution lives in §6 with stakeholder provenance, which is NOT a code citation. NEVER flip a claim's marker to `[VERIFIED]`/`[INFERRED]` off a stakeholder answer; `generate-intent --kb` consumes the resolved §6 entries (its routing table carries them into the vault as pre-resolved OQs).
- **Display context comes from the HOME MODULE (7.22.1):** the Step 2a context slots MUST be derived from the OQ's own module PRD-kontrak (lede, claim rows + citations, §2/§3 mermaid flows) — never skipped wholesale just because the §6 line itself carries no citation/hint. Rail + slot-by-slot sources: `references/interactive-walk.md` Step 2a "KB-mode slot sources". Same for the recommendation lane: the home module is probed FIRST (`references/recommendation-context.md` source 1, modern grammar).
- Steps 0.5/0.6 apply with the KB substituted for the vault (resume = the `## Resolution rounds` lines; scope options unchanged); Steps 3–4's vault-metadata work is replaced by the round line above.

## Hard rules (the rails)

- **No invention.** Every resolution comes from user input in this session. Never auto-fill answers from prior knowledge, reasoning, or industry defaults. `idk` / `whatever` / `any default` → push back, offer **Defer** and route to the stakeholder.
- **"Answer all OQs for me" → refuse** (this rail governs ANSWERS — inventing content). The point of this skill is capturing *stakeholder* answers. Offer to mark unknowns Deferred, or route specific OQs to a read-doc query. The P3 express auto-defer does NOT breach this rail: it invents NO answer — it postpones P2/P3 on the record (a recorded defer is a decision artifact, not a fabricated resolution), and the blocking tier is always asked.
- **Tag preservation.** Every OQ tag survives resolution — the marker preserves the identifier for commits, PRs, and downstream references.
- **The derive run is mandatory** after each Resolve / Out-of-Scope / Defer outcome's markdown edits: **Run** `bash <plugin>/scripts/derive-vault-json.sh --vault <VAULT_DIR> --event '{"event":"oq-resolved|oq-deferred|oq-out-of-scope","id":"OQ-XXX","at":"<iso>","action":"A|B|C"}'` (+ `--patch <tmp-patch>` for DEFER RECORDS — a temp FILE whose content is `{"open_questions":{"OQ-XXX":{"defer_to":"binding"}}}` for binding-defers or `…"defer_to":"stakeholder"…` for stakeholder/auto-defers; `--patch` never takes inline JSON). The script recomputes status/summary/adrs/entities from the markdown and holds the `vault.json.lock` itself — exit 4 → surface the `memory_in_use` halt (keterangan unchanged); never hand-edit vault.json.
- **Read-only on code.** The skill never modifies code files. Deferred-to-binding OQs resolve later at `bind-codebase`; code patches happen later still in `execute-bolts`.
- **Atomicity + idempotency.** Each OQ resolution is a self-contained edit; bailing mid-loop preserves partial progress. Re-running on a partially-resolved vault resumes from current state without rewriting already-resolved entries.
- **Lock has audit consequences.** Unlocking a `🔒 LOCKED` vault is recorded in the round's Changelog; the user re-locks and re-signs-off afterward.

## When to push back

**Always:** vault not found / malformed → STOP (do not generate one — that's `generate-intent`); OQ list empty → tell the user, suggest another scope/vault; "answer all OQs for me" → refuse (offer Defer); `idk`/`whatever`/`any default` → push back, offer Defer.

**Conditional:** a resolution contradicts an existing ADR (`vault.md ## Decisions`; legacy `05-decisions.md`) → STOP, ask whether to supersede (`Status: Supersedes D-XXX`) or reformulate; a resolution depends on another still-open OQ → flag, resolve the dependency first or Defer; the answer expands beyond the OQ scope → ask whether to split across OQs or capture the expansion as new OQs.

## Quality bar

No invention; tag preservation; full auditability (Changelog + per-OQ markers = what was decided when, by whom if named); idempotent resume; atomic per-OQ edits. These are non-negotiable — see the self-check in `references/interactive-walk.md`.

## Specialist references (load on demand)

- **`references/interactive-walk.md`** — the full Step 0–5 procedure and the **canonical shape of the single per-OQ prompt**: vault location + lock check, resume, scope, parse, per-OQ display + the one collapsed `AskUserQuestion` (4 slots + Other + Esc, keterangan rules, the alternatives-as-prose rule, the no-recommendation shape, the "Other" parse order, Esc = end the walk), the Defer two-question follow-up and the OOS rationale follow-up verbatim, per-action state transitions, Resolve/Skip/Defer/OOS apply logic, cross-cutting multi-doc landing by disclosure, promoted-entry formatting per target doc, the per-action derive `--event`/`--patch` args, the version + Changelog template, the self-check list, and the summary format.
- **`references/binding-mode.md`** — the `--binding <binding.md>` flow: CONFLICT detail-block walk (KEEP_VAULT / KEEP_CODE / DEFER / SPLIT), propagated deferred-OQ walk, write-back to `binding.md` + `vault.json`, hand-off, and hard rails.
- **`references/recommendation-context.md`** — context-aware `(recommended)` answers per OQ: source priority (KB `[VERIFIED]` → vault → codebase-map → silent fallback), anti-halu invariants, citation probe, what the recommendation contributes to the single prompt (slot `[1]` + its description, and how the considered alternatives are written as question-text prose; the shape itself is owned by `interactive-walk.md` and is not restated there), the high-stakes marker, and the audit trail. *Open per-OQ at slot-`[1]` build time — the walk attempts a recommendation for every OQ (`resolution_mode: recommend` REQUIRES it; silent no-yield per the walk stays canonical); never pre-load it for the whole walk.*

Source vault must be a `mega-sdd` vault with the standard structure (layout-2 4-file or legacy 7-file) and OQ tagging convention (`OQ-{DOC_CODE}-{N}` with `P1|P2|P3`). 5. For `Promoted`, format the new entry per the target doc's existing convention:
   - `vault.md ## Decisions` (legacy `05-decisions.md`): ADR-lite per the `OUTPUT_MODE` of the vault (compact = 1-paragraph; full = multi-section). Set `**Status**: Accepted`, `**Date**: YYYY-MM`, `**Source**: resolve-oq session YYYY-MM-DD + <stakeholder/PIC if user named one>`. Cross-reference the resolved OQ tag in the Context line.
   - `model.md`: append constraint to relevant entity's DBML notes, or update the field-level validation table. Add comment `// Resolves OQ-DM-N`.
   - Other docs: append to the appropriate sub-section, with a `> Resolves OQ-{tag}` annotation.
6. Write the changes to the file(s) using `Edit`.
7. Legacy vaults only: also mark the roll-up entry in `00-index.md` `[x]` with the same pointer (layout-2 has no roll-up — the constraints.md line IS the entry).
8. **Run** `bash <plugin>/scripts/derive-vault-json.sh --vault <VAULT_DIR> --event '{"event":"oq-resolved","id":"OQ-XXX","at":"<iso>","action":"A"}'` — the script flips the OQ's `status` to `resolved` from the `[x]` checkbox, stamps `resolved_at`, recomputes `open_questions_summary`, and picks up the new ADR in `adrs[]` / changed entity in `entities[]` from the markdown.
9. Show the user a confirmation summary of the diff (target file(s), inline-vs-promoted, the new `D-XXX` if any). **This is narration, not a prompt** — but it is where a wrong destination is still correctable: if the user objects, re-land the entry and re-run the derive. No extra `AskUserQuestion`.

**If `Out of Scope`** (the ONE sanctioned second prompt on this path — a rationale is recorded state and may not be invented):

Ask the user for the rationale (1 sentence — why is this not in scope for the project?) with ONE
`AskUserQuestion` carrying ONE question. The rationale may **never** be defaulted, derived from the
OQ text, or inferred — an unasked `out_of_scope_reason` is an invariant-#5 breach. Same language
precedence as Step 2b; the strings below are the default rendering.

```
question: |
  Out of scope untuk: "{full OQ question text, verbatim}"  ({OQ tag}, dari {origin doc})

  Alasannya apa? Alasan ini masuk ke entri `## Out of Scope` dan terbaca di audit trail — jadi
  tulis yang bisa dipertanggungjawabkan, bukan "tidak perlu". Kalau alasannya di luar empat
  pilihan ini, pilih "Other" dan ketik sendiri: teks "Other" tercatat VERBATIM apa adanya,
  sedangkan memilih salah satu kategori di bawah mencatat kategori itu dalam bahasa isi vault.
  • Tekan Esc = BATALKAN penetapan out-of-scope ini DAN AKHIRI SELURUH walk: OQ tetap `[ ]` open, tidak ada perubahan file, skill lompat ke Step 3 (bump versi + Changelog) lalu keluar.
header: "out of scope"   # short; the OQ tag + question text ride THIS question's own body above — every follow-up question must carry them itself, never rely on a sibling question that may be omitted
multiSelect: false
options:
  - label: "Di luar scope rilis ini"
    description: "Tercatat sebagai: 'di luar scope rilis ini'. Entri pindah ke `## Out of Scope`
                  di {origin doc}, marker jadi `[~]`. Kalau ada nomor rilis/target spesifik,
                  pakai 'Other' supaya tercatat verbatim."
  - label: "Ditangani sistem/tim lain"
    description: "Tercatat sebagai: 'ditangani sistem/tim lain'. Entri pindah ke
                  `## Out of Scope` di {origin doc}, marker jadi `[~]`. Sebutkan sistem/tim-nya
                  lewat 'Other' kalau perlu jejak yang lebih spesifik."
  - label: "Sudah tidak relevan (requirement berubah)"
    description: "Tercatat sebagai: 'sudah tidak relevan — requirement berubah'. Entri pindah ke
                  `## Out of Scope` di {origin doc}, marker jadi `[~]`."
  - label: "Bukan tanggung jawab produk ini"
    description: "Tercatat sebagai: 'bukan tanggung jawab produk ini'. Entri pindah ke
                  `## Out of Scope` di {origin doc}, marker jadi `[~]`."
  # "Other" = tulis alasanmu sendiri; itu yang tercatat verbatim. Esc sudah dijelaskan di question
  #           text di atas (batal + walk berakhir) — konsisten dengan Esc di Step 2b, dan sengaja
  #           TIDAK ditinggal hanya di komentar ini: operator tidak membaca komentar YAML.
```

If the user presses Esc here, **nothing is recorded** — the OOS is abandoned, the OQ stays `[ ]`
open, and the walk ends per the Step-2b Esc semantics. Never fall back to a canned rationale.

Then:

1. The rationale is in hand (the chosen category, recorded per the recorded-language rule above, or
   the "Other" free text verbatim).
2. Move the OQ entry to the same doc's `## Out of Scope` section with format: `- <original question text>. (was OQ-XXX-N, declared OOS v{X.Y} on YYYY-MM-DD: <rationale>)`.
3. In the original `## Open Questions` section, mark the OQ `[~]` with a one-line pointer: `[~] **OQ-XXX-N** [P{x}]: <original question> → Out of Scope v{X.Y}: see Out of Scope section.`
4. Legacy vaults only: update the roll-up entry in `00-index.md` similarly.
5. **Run** `bash <plugin>/scripts/derive-vault-json.sh --vault <VAULT_DIR> --event '{"event":"oq-out-of-scope","id":"OQ-XXX","at":"<iso>","action":"C"}'` — the `[~]` marker derives `status: out_of_scope` and the summary recomputes.

# Constraints & Open Questions

> **TL;DR**: Batasan teknis/bisnis, NFR, dan satu-satunya daftar Open Question vault ini · Architect, Tech Lead, PM · baca sebelum memilih solusi atau menguji rilis.

## Technical constraints

- **Akses**: tiga halaman dan form Kontak bisa dipakai tanpa login (PRD §Latar belakang · §Ruang lingkup).
- **Integrasi**: tidak ada integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).
- **Konten**: konten statis dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri (PRD §Open questions).
- **Perangkat**: Beranda responsif di 375px dan desktop (PRD §Halaman Beranda). Cakupan halaman lain: OQ-CN-3.

## Business constraints

- **Ruang lingkup rilis**: tiga halaman publik + satu form (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- **Admin**: membaca pesan langsung dari database; tidak ada UI admin (PRD §Tujuan).
- **Timeline / budget / regulasi**: tidak disebut di PRD.

## Non-functional requirements

| Category | Requirement | Source |
|----------|-------------|--------|
| Performance | Halaman statis termuat < 2 detik di koneksi 3G | PRD §Non-functional |
| Accessibility | Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi | PRD §Non-functional |
| Security | Input form di-escape saat ditampilkan; tidak ada HTML mentah dari pengunjung | PRD §Non-functional |

## Design system

### Accessibility

- Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi (PRD §Non-functional — Aksesibilitas).
- Level WCAG: tidak disebut di PRD — tidak diasumsikan.

---

## Sources

- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup · §Halaman Beranda · §Non-functional · §Open questions

## Out of Scope

- Notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- Target ketersediaan (uptime) dan skalabilitas — tidak disebut PRD, tidak diasumsikan.

## Open Questions

- [ ] **OQ-AR-1** [P1] [tech / recommend] [conf: medium] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: Pesan dari form Kontak harus disimpan ke tabel `contact_messages`, tapi aplikasi ini belum punya database sendiri — semua datanya lewat API upstream (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`, dipakai `src/libs/api/server.ts:9`). Tabel itu tinggal di database mana: di layanan upstream (aplikasi hanya meneruskan lewat route proxy), atau database baru di dalam aplikasi ini? — resolve: binding (lihat Auto-Classification Review)
  **Deferred**: project_scale=xs — auto-deferred at generation; resolves at binding (brownfield) / resurfaces via resolve-oq (greenfield), tidak ditanya interaktif

# Constraints & Open Questions

> **TL;DR**: Batasan teknis/bisnis, NFR, dan satu-satunya daftar Open Question vault ini · Architect, Tech Lead, PM · baca sebelum memilih solusi atau menguji rilis.

## Technical constraints

- **Akses**: tiga halaman dan form Kontak bisa dipakai tanpa login (PRD §Latar belakang · §Ruang lingkup).
- **Integrasi**: tidak ada integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).
- **Konten**: konten statis dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri (PRD §Open questions).
- **Perangkat**: Beranda responsif di 375px dan desktop (PRD §Halaman Beranda). Cakupan halaman lain: OQ-CN-3.

## Business constraints

- **Ruang lingkup rilis**: tiga halaman publik + satu form (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- **Admin**: membaca pesan langsung dari database; tidak ada UI admin (PRD §Tujuan).
- **Timeline / budget / regulasi**: tidak disebut di PRD.

## Non-functional requirements

| Category | Requirement | Source |
|----------|-------------|--------|
| Performance | Halaman statis termuat < 2 detik di koneksi 3G | PRD §Non-functional |
| Accessibility | Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi | PRD §Non-functional |
| Security | Input form di-escape saat ditampilkan; tidak ada HTML mentah dari pengunjung | PRD §Non-functional |

## Design system

### Accessibility

- Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi (PRD §Non-functional — Aksesibilitas).
- Level WCAG: tidak disebut di PRD — tidak diasumsikan.

## Sources

- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup · §Halaman Beranda · §Non-functional · §Open questions

## Out of Scope

- Notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- Target ketersediaan (uptime) dan skalabilitas — tidak disebut PRD, tidak diasumsikan.

# Company Profile Mini — Grand Design

> Situs profil publik sederhana: tiga halaman statis (Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak) dan satu form kontak yang menyimpan pesan ke database.

Protokol baca vault (OQ, halt, istilah standar): `_meta/ai-consumer-guide.md`.

## Phase context

**Phase:** 1 of 1

**Project type:** single-phase

## Overview

> **TL;DR**: Apa produknya, siapa penggunanya, apa yang di luar lingkup · PM, Architect, QA · baca pertama kali.

### Product

Halaman profil publik untuk sebuah unit kerja: siapa mereka, apa layanannya, dan cara menghubungi. Pengunjung membaca profil tanpa login dan bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak; pesan tersimpan di database.

### Target users / personas

- **Pengunjung**: membaca profil dan layanan, lalu mengirim pesan lewat form Kontak (PRD §Latar belakang, §Tujuan).
- **Admin**: membaca pesan yang masuk langsung dari database — tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini (PRD §Tujuan).

### Problem

Unit kerja belum punya halaman profil publik yang menjelaskan siapa mereka, layanannya, dan cara menghubungi mereka (PRD §Latar belakang).

### Success criteria

- Pengunjung membaca profil dan daftar layanan dalam satu kunjungan (PRD §Tujuan).
- Pengunjung bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak, dan pesannya tersimpan agar bisa dibaca admin lewat database (PRD §Tujuan).

### Sources

- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup

### Out of Scope

- Autentikasi, panel admin, notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- UI admin untuk membaca pesan (PRD §Tujuan).
- Integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).

## Architecture

> **TL;DR**: Tiga halaman publik + satu handler kirim pesan + satu tabel · Architect, FE/BE Dev · baca sebelum menentukan route dan penyimpanan.

### System overview

Pengunjung membuka tiga halaman publik lewat browser. Konten Beranda dan Tentang Kami statis, diambil dari file konfigurasi. Form di Halaman Kontak dikirim ke server; server memvalidasi tiga field lalu menyimpan pesan ke tabel `contact_messages`. Admin membaca tabel itu langsung di database.

```text
Pengunjung (browser)
  ├─ Beranda ──────── tombol ──▶ Kontak
  ├─ Tentang Kami ─── tautan ──▶ Beranda
  └─ Kontak ── kirim form ──▶ Server: validasi 3 field ──▶ contact_messages
                                                            ▲
                                   Admin (baca langsung di database)
```

### Web Frontend

| Component | Purpose | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Halaman Beranda | Judul organisasi, tagline satu kalimat, ringkasan tiga layanan utama (judul + satu paragraf per layanan), tombol menuju Halaman Kontak; responsif di 375px dan desktop | PRD §Halaman Beranda |
| Halaman Tentang Kami | Profil singkat (dua–tiga paragraf statis), daftar tim (nama + peran, tanpa foto), tautan kembali ke Beranda | PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami |
| Halaman Kontak | Form nama/email/pesan; pesan sukses di halaman yang sama; error per field, isi form tidak hilang | PRD §Halaman Kontak |
| File konfigurasi konten | Sumber konten statis (nama organisasi, layanan, tim); isi placeholder, diganti tim sendiri | PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Open questions |

**Tech stack (Web Frontend)**: tidak dinyatakan di PRD — dicatat sebagai OQ-AR-6 (resolved dari manifest repo).

### Backend

| Component | Purpose | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Handler kirim pesan | Validasi sisi server tiga field, simpan ke `contact_messages` beserta `created_at` | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |
| Tabel `contact_messages` | Menyimpan pesan pengunjung; dibaca admin langsung via database | PRD §Data model · §Tujuan |

Lokasi tabel (database upstream vs database baru di aplikasi) belum ditentukan PRD — OQ-AR-1.

### Integrations

Tidak ada integrasi eksternal di rilis ini (PRD §Latar belakang).

### API contracts

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose | Auth | Errors | Source |
|----------|--------|---------|------|--------|--------|
| TBD — OQ-AR-2 | TBD — OQ-AR-2 | Terima `name`, `email`, `message`; validasi sisi server; simpan ke `contact_messages` | Tanpa login (publik) | Error validasi per field (`name` / `email` / `message`) | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |

### Sources

- PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Halaman Kontak · §Data model · §Alur

### Out of Scope

- UI admin, panel admin, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup · §Tujuan).
- Foto anggota tim (PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami).

## Decisions

### D-001: Semua halaman publik tanpa login

Situs ditujukan untuk pengunjung umum. **Decision**: Beranda, Tentang Kami, dan Kontak (termasuk kirim form) bisa diakses tanpa autentikasi. **Consequences**: tidak ada sesi pengguna; proteksi route aplikasi perlu pengecualian khusus untuk tiga halaman ini. **Source**: PRD §Latar belakang ("Tidak ada login") · §Ruang lingkup.

### D-002: Konten statis dari file konfigurasi, bukan CMS

Konten jarang berubah dan CMS di luar lingkup. **Decision**: nama organisasi, layanan, dan tim diambil dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri. **Consequences**: ubah konten = ubah file + deploy ulang. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Ruang lingkup · §Open questions.

### D-003: Validasi di server, hasil tampil di halaman yang sama

**Decision**: form Kontak divalidasi di sisi server; valid → simpan ke `contact_messages` dan tampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; tidak valid → error per field dan isi form tetap. **Consequences**: aturan validasi berlaku di server, bukan hanya di browser. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001.

### D-004: Tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini

**Decision**: admin membaca pesan langsung dari database. **Consequences**: tidak ada halaman daftar pesan, tidak ada notifikasi. **Source**: PRD §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup.

## Auto-Classification Review

> Total classified: 11 OQs. Auto-resolution active: 2 (tech, high-confidence — resolved at generation from repo probes). Manual review recommended: 3 (business, low-confidence). Auto-deferred (xs): 4.

| OQ-AR-6 | Stack web dan test runner apa yang dipakai? | tech / scan | high | resolved at generation — `package.json:40` · `package.json:88` |
| OQ-FL-1 | Teks pesan error per field | business | low | needs review — conservative default |
| OQ-CN-1 | Proteksi spam form publik | business | low | needs review — conservative default |
| OQ-CN-3 | Syarat responsif untuk semua halaman | business | low | needs review — conservative default |

### Auto-deferred (project_scale: xs)

- OQ-AR-1 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); lokasi tabel `contact_messages`.
- OQ-AR-2 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); alamat endpoint kirim form.
- OQ-AR-4 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); lokasi + format file konfigurasi konten.
- OQ-AR-5 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); URL tiga halaman.

147	
148	     # An OQ is "implementation-relevant" to this unit when:
149	     # - the OQ's resolution touches files in unit.target_files, OR

151	     # - the OQ's `priority: P1` (P1 OQs are always implementation-critical per vault-core)
152	
153	     relevant_oqs = filter oq_ids_in_table by above criteria
154	     missing = relevant_oqs - oq_ids_in_binding_refs
155	
156	     IF missing is non-empty:

Model-executed check (no deterministic validator; the bolt-side B1 postflight cite-check is the backstop).

# generate-units — post-write validation passes (Step 12.x)

## Contents
- 12.3 — Per-anchor verification
- 12.4 — Inject constitution clauses
- 12.4.5 — Framework pack provenance citation
- 12.5 — Polished-prompt render pass (a–g)
- 12.6 — Deduplication check
- 12.7 — Sibling-consistency sweep

Loaded by `generate-units/SKILL.md` Step 12. The 12.x sub-procedures run in declared order, then step 13 logs the audit event so it reflects all post-write validation outcomes. The emitted YAML for every blocker named here is in the halt-protocol reference listed in the skill router.

## 12.3 — Per-anchor verification (runs FIRST as a precondition check before constitution inject + render)

Per the §Step 12.3 per-anchor check in the defensive-generation reference (listed in the skill router). For each Anchor entry in each unit's `## Anchors` section:

1. Parse `<file>:<line-range> — <description>` format
2. Probe file existence (fs OR codebase-map §1)
3. Apply outcome:
   - **File MISSING + greenfield unit** → WARNING in unit body footer (HTML comment): "anchor aspirational for new file; verify before bolt"
   - **File MISSING + brownfield unit** → stronger WARNING: "anchor points to non-existent file; binding may be incomplete; review"
   - **File EXISTS, line out of bounds** → WARNING: "anchor line-range may have drifted; current file has N lines"
   - **File EXISTS, line valid** → ✓ verified

Anchor warnings are SOFT — they do NOT halt generation. Anchors can be aspirational (especially for new files in `create` units). Warnings surface visually in chat output + unit body footer so user can review.

## 12.4 — Inject constitution clauses

Per `generate-intent/references/vault-core.md §constitution`.

For each unit, read `<vault>/constitution.md` + identify clauses relevant to the unit's:
- target_files paths (matches §A clauses for files in those paths)
- task_type (different clauses apply for create vs extend vs verify)
- module (per `_meta/modules.yaml` if multi-module)
- vault_source (clauses referenced in that vault section)

Inject relevant clauses into the unit's `## Hard rules` section:

```yaml
id: constitution-A-001
language: <unit's primary language>
message: "All API endpoints MUST use Sanctum auth middleware (constitution §A-001)"
rule:
  pattern: |
    Route::$$$('/api/$$$', $$$)
  not:
    inside:
      pattern: |
        ->middleware(['auth:sanctum', $$$])
```

Format:
- Rule `id` prefix `constitution-` + clause ID
- `message` cites clause source
- Pattern detection: convert clause text to ast-grep YAML when feasible; fall back to text-match grep when not
- Severity: `error` (constitution clauses are non-negotiable; halts bolt commit if violated)

**Anti-halu rails**:
- Constitution clauses NEVER silently apply — surface in unit body for user review
- Clauses that can't translate to ast-grep grammar are flagged in unit body as `## Constitution warnings` informational section (not Hard Rule)
- Anti-pattern (§D) clauses always inject as Anti-patterns (informational), not Hard Rules (machine-validated), unless mechanically detectable
- Constitution version + hash tracked: if constitution drifts between unit generation and bolt execution → halt `constitution_drift_detected`

## 12.4.5 — Framework pack provenance citation

When `binding.md` §Suggested Unit Hard Rules contains rules sourced from framework pack (introduced by bind-codebase Step 2.8), emit each pack-derived Hard Rule into the unit's `## Hard rules` section WITH explicit provenance citation. Tools consuming the unit must see WHICH framework pack rule applies (audit trail, debugging, override decisions).

**One grammar per unit (S6 EB-GATE-7).** A unit's `## Hard rules` carries EITHER v1 dash productions OR v2 fenced ast-grep YAML — never both (`hard_rule_mixed_grammar` halts at bolt time). Pack rules translate per the pack→bolt table in `bind-codebase/references/hard-rules-and-packs.md §2.9a`: when the unit's other rules are v1 (binding-suggested `DO NOT modify …`), emit the pack rule as its v1 production (or Anti-pattern) — do NOT drop a fenced YAML block into a v1 unit; when the pack carries a real ast-grep `rule:` body and the unit has no v1 rules, emit v2 fenced YAML (the shape below) for ALL of the unit's rules — v2 rules require `ast-grep` at bolt pre-flight (HALTs `dep_missing` if absent); run `/mega-sdd:install-deps --tools=ast-grep` ahead of execute-bolts if it isn't installed yet.

Format inside unit's `## Hard rules` section:

```yaml
- id: framework-pack-naming-001
  source: "framework-conventions/laravel-base-26.md §Hard Rules — UUID PK enforcement"
  framework: laravel-base-26
  framework_pack_version: 1.0  # framework_version_range when last_verified_against passed
  message: "Domain entity migrations MUST use UUID primary key per starterkit convention"
  severity: error
  rule:
    pattern: |
      $table->id()
    inside:
      pattern: |
        Schema::create($_, function (Blueprint $table) { $$$ })
```

Aggregate in unit body:

```markdown
## Framework pack source

Conventions enforced from: `plugins/mega-sdd/references/framework-conventions/laravel-base-26.md` (v1.0, extends `laravel.md` extends `_universal.md`)
Rules pulled into this unit's Hard Rules: N (see §Hard rules for line-level enforcement)
```

**Anti-halu rails**:
- Framework pack rules NEVER silently apply — citation mandatory so user can audit + override
- Rules whose `path_glob` doesn't match this unit's `target_files` are SKIPPED (not all pack rules apply to every unit)
- When pack `extends:` chain → cite the SPECIFIC pack file the rule lives in (not the chain head), so override edits are traceable

## 12.5 — Polished-prompt render pass

After all units written but BEFORE the dedup check, sweep each unit and validate the prompt-shape contract per the unit-schema reference (listed in the skill router):

a. **Anchors presence rule**:
   - `task_type: verify` OR `task_type: extend` → `## Anchors` section MUST have ≥1 entry. Missing → halt `unit_underspecified`.
   - `task_type: create` AND ≥1 `binding_refs` entry pointing to a related pattern → `## Anchors` MUST have ≥1 entry citing the closest pattern. Missing → halt `unit_underspecified`.
   - `task_type: create` AND fully greenfield (no binding) → Anchors section optional.

b. **Hard rules grammar parse**: each DASH line under `## Hard rules` MUST match one of the 5 strict v1 productions OR the generic-directive tier (`MUST/MUST NOT/DO NOT/NEVER/ALWAYS …` — accepted but counted `hard_rules_directive_prose`; not machine-checkable at bolt time, so post-flight records it `directive_unverified` unless attested). Fenced ```yaml blocks are v2 ast-grep rules (validated by parse-via-scan at bolt pre-flight). A line matching neither → halt `hard_rule_unparseable` with the offending line. Mixing v1 dash rules and v2 fenced blocks in ONE unit → the bolt-time `hard_rule_mixed_grammar` halt — emit one grammar per unit (12.4.5).

c. **Directive prose check on Implementation steps**:
   - Extract the body of `## Implementation steps`
   - If body is pure bullet list (no sentence >15 words detected) → emit WARNING (not halt) in chat: "Unit U-XXX Implementation steps is bullet-only. Consider directive prose for AI coding consumption."
   - For `task_type: verify`: the single-line "No code changes..." sentence is acceptable as-is (special case).

d. **Migration notes rule**:
   - `task_type: extend` → `## Migration notes` MUST exist AND have all three sub-lists (REMOVE / KEEP / ADD) populated (any can be `none` but must be present). Missing → halt `unit_underspecified`.
   - `task_type: create` OR `task_type: verify` → `## Migration notes` section MUST be absent.

e. **Anti-patterns harvesting (suggestion, not requirement)**:
   - If binding has CONFLICTs or KB has gotchas in domains this unit covers → suggest filling `## Anti-patterns` section with the relevant items
   - Auto-populate from `binding.md` "## Suggested Unit Hard Rules" and KB `## 9. Edge Cases & Gotchas` sections when applicable
   - Anti-patterns are guidance only — no halt if absent

f. **Starterkit citation check**:

   ```
   IF unit.frontmatter.starterkit_context_consumed == true:
     FOR EACH hard_rule in unit.hard_rules:
       IF hard_rule.source == "starterkit-context.yaml" AND hard_rule.citation field is missing or empty:
         → HALT `starterkit_rule_citation_missing`  (ALWAYS STOP — blocker YAML in the halt-protocol reference)
         → do NOT write the unit
   ```

g. **OQ-ID propagation check** (audit response 2026-05-27 §F):

   Every Open Question that influenced this unit's content MUST appear in `binding_refs:` frontmatter. An OQ "influenced" the unit when its resolution (per `binding.md` or `binding-<phase>.md` Resolution Table) corresponds to design choices reflected in the unit body, target_files, hard rules, or migration notes.

   ```

     oq_ids_in_binding_refs = unit.frontmatter.binding_refs intersect (OQ-* prefix)

     # An OQ is "implementation-relevant" to this unit when:
     # - the OQ's resolution touches files in unit.target_files, OR
     # - the OQ's resolution text appears semantically in unit.body (anchors, hard rules, migration notes), OR
     # - the OQ's `priority: P1` (P1 OQs are always implementation-critical per vault-core)

     relevant_oqs = filter oq_ids_in_table by above criteria
     missing = relevant_oqs - oq_ids_in_binding_refs

     IF missing is non-empty:
       → HALT `unit_oq_trace_missing`  (blocker YAML in the halt-protocol reference)
   ```

CONFLICTs already propagate via this same mechanism; this rail extends the discipline to OQs.

### h. PBT properties citation check (when `properties:` present)

Every entry in a unit's `properties:` array MUST carry a non-empty `cites:` field resolving to a vault section / binding claim / KB rule (per `references/pbt-integration.md` §citation). # Adversarial Acceptance-Test Review Prompt

> Prompt template for `generate-units` Step 9.5 — adversarial review of acceptance_test authored in Step 9. Closes audit Pattern F structural risk (D4-006): "Never trust AI to both generate and validate" (ACM FSE 2025).

**Consumed by:** `generate-units/SKILL.md` Step 9.5
**Output target:** updates `acceptance_test` in unit frontmatter with merged gap assertions + sets `_authored_by:` provenance field

## Contents
- Default mode (main-thread self-re-prompt)
- Opt-in subagent mode (`--adversarial-subagent`)
- Gap merge logic (Step 9.5 post-review)
- `_authored_by:` provenance values
- Anti-halu rails

---

## Default mode (main-thread self-re-prompt)

The main thread, after authoring the unit body + acceptance_test in Step 9, re-prompts itself with the following framing BEFORE writing the unit file. No subagent dispatch needed.

```
ROLE: QA engineer reviewing an acceptance_test for completeness.

UNIT (verbatim from Step 9):
<paste the just-generated unit body>

CURRENT acceptance_test (verbatim):
<paste the just-generated acceptance_test block>

YOUR JOB:
Find AT LEAST 2 cases where this acceptance_test would FAIL to catch a real
bug in the implementation. For each case:

- Describe the bug scenario (e.g., "what if user_id is null but the request
  still returns HTTP 200?")
- Identify which existing test assertion would miss it (e.g., "test only
  checks HTTP status code; never inspects response body shape")
- Propose the additional test assertion that would catch it (test code OR
  natural-language assertion the bolt subagent can translate)

Be ADVERSARIAL: assume the original test author had blind spots. The goal is
to find what they missed, NOT to validate what they wrote. If the test looks
"obviously fine" to you, look harder — that's a sign you're inheriting the
same blind spots.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT rewrite the entire acceptance_test. Only identify gaps and propose
  targeted additions.
- Do NOT propose gaps that are out-of-scope for this unit (e.g., suggesting
  load tests when the unit is about CRUD correctness). Per-unit scope matters.
- If the unit body is genuinely tight and the test covers it well, return
  `coverage_verdict: strong` + empty `gaps_identified`. Honest "no gaps
  found" is better than fabricated gaps.

OUTPUT FORMAT (strict YAML):
```yaml
adversarial_review:
  reviewer_pass: 2                          # always 2 (after Step 9 = pass 1)
  gaps_identified:
    - scenario: "<bug case description>"
      missed_by_assertion: "<which existing assertion fails to catch it>"
      proposed_additional_assertion: "<test code or natural language>"
    # repeat per gap; aim for AT LEAST 2 unless coverage_verdict is strong
  coverage_verdict: weak | adequate | strong
```
```

## Opt-in subagent mode (`--adversarial-subagent` flag)

When user passes `--adversarial-subagent` to `generate-units`, OR when unit frontmatter declares `risk: high`, dispatch a SEPARATE subagent for the adversarial review. Separate LLM context = stronger blind-spot coverage at the cost of one extra dispatch per high-risk unit.

> **Who writes `risk:`** — generate-units Step 2.5 stamps the frontmatter field when a unit's target_files/binding_refs hit the risk signals (auth/authn/authz surfaces, payment/money movement, PII/regulated data, `[LOCKED]`-claim refs, security-sensitive packs). Without the stamp, escalation only fires via the manual `--adversarial-subagent` flag.

- Model: sonnet (default; opus for `risk: critical` units)
- Tool surface: Read, Grep (read-only)
- Wall-clock budget: ≤3 min per unit
- Output format: same YAML structure as default mode

Subagent is dispatched per-unit; main thread iterates units sequentially when `--adversarial-subagent` is set (no parallel — keeps simplifikasi).

## Gap merge logic (generate-units Step 9.5 post-review)

Main thread (NOT the adversarial reviewer) handles merge:

1. If `coverage_verdict: strong` AND `gaps_identified: []` → keep original acceptance_test as-is; set `_authored_by: adversarial-reviewed (no gaps)`
2. If `gaps_identified: [...]` non-empty → for each gap, append `proposed_additional_assertion` to acceptance_test as new test case. Set `_authored_by: adversarial-reviewed (+N gaps merged)` where N = count
3. If `coverage_verdict: weak` AND `gaps_identified: []` (incoherent) → keep original acceptance_test; set `_authored_by: adversarial-review-failed (kept original; manual review recommended)`. Log warning to chat.

## `_authored_by:` provenance values (canonical)

| Value | Origin | Trust signal |
|---|---|---|
| `same-pass` | legacy unit (field absent) OR `--no-adversarial-review` flag set | weakest |
| `adversarial-reviewed` | default; gaps merged or no-gap finding | recommended baseline |
| `adversarial-reviewed (no gaps)` | adversarial pass found nothing to add | strong |
| `adversarial-reviewed (+N gaps merged)` | N gaps merged into test | strong |
| `adversarial-review-failed` | adversarial pass returned incoherent output | weak + warning |
| `independent-llm` | `--adversarial-subagent` flag, separate subagent extended test | strongest LLM |
| `human` | user manually edited acceptance_test post-generation | strongest overall |

Legacy units (no field present) → treat as `same-pass` for execute-bolts surface logic.

## Anti-halu rails

- Adversarial reviewer MUST NOT modify the unit body — only proposes test additions
- Adversarial reviewer MUST output strict YAML matching the schema above; parse failures → fallback to `same-pass` provenance + log warning
- `--no-adversarial-review` flag preserved for users who explicitly want the same-pass behavior (debug / regression testing)
- Legacy units re-encountered by `generate-units --regenerate` get the adversarial review pass on rewrite; user-marked `_authored_by: human` units are preserved untouched

# Company Profile Mini — Grand Design

> Situs profil publik sederhana: tiga halaman statis (Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak) dan satu form kontak yang menyimpan pesan ke database.

Protokol baca vault (OQ, halt, istilah standar): `_meta/ai-consumer-guide.md`.

## Phase context

**Phase:** 1 of 1

**Project type:** single-phase

## Overview

> **TL;DR**: Apa produknya, siapa penggunanya, apa yang di luar lingkup · PM, Architect, QA · baca pertama kali.

### Product

Halaman profil publik untuk sebuah unit kerja: siapa mereka, apa layanannya, dan cara menghubungi. Pengunjung membaca profil tanpa login dan bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak; pesan tersimpan di database.

### Target users / personas

- **Pengunjung**: membaca profil dan layanan, lalu mengirim pesan lewat form Kontak (PRD §Latar belakang, §Tujuan).
- **Admin**: membaca pesan yang masuk langsung dari database — tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini (PRD §Tujuan).

### Problem

Unit kerja belum punya halaman profil publik yang menjelaskan siapa mereka, layanannya, dan cara menghubungi mereka (PRD §Latar belakang).

### Success criteria

- Pengunjung membaca profil dan daftar layanan dalam satu kunjungan (PRD §Tujuan).
- Pengunjung bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak, dan pesannya tersimpan agar bisa dibaca admin lewat database (PRD §Tujuan).

### Sources

- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup

### Out of Scope

- Autentikasi, panel admin, notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
- UI admin untuk membaca pesan (PRD §Tujuan).
- Integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).

## Architecture

> **TL;DR**: Tiga halaman publik + satu handler kirim pesan + satu tabel · Architect, FE/BE Dev · baca sebelum menentukan route dan penyimpanan.

### System overview

Pengunjung membuka tiga halaman publik lewat browser. Konten Beranda dan Tentang Kami statis, diambil dari file konfigurasi. Form di Halaman Kontak dikirim ke server; server memvalidasi tiga field lalu menyimpan pesan ke tabel `contact_messages`. Admin membaca tabel itu langsung di database.

```text
Pengunjung (browser)
  ├─ Beranda ──────── tombol ──▶ Kontak
  ├─ Tentang Kami ─── tautan ──▶ Beranda
  └─ Kontak ── kirim form ──▶ Server: validasi 3 field ──▶ contact_messages
                                                            ▲
                                   Admin (baca langsung di database)
```

### Web Frontend

| Component | Purpose | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Halaman Beranda | Judul organisasi, tagline satu kalimat, ringkasan tiga layanan utama (judul + satu paragraf per layanan), tombol menuju Halaman Kontak; responsif di 375px dan desktop | PRD §Halaman Beranda |
| Halaman Tentang Kami | Profil singkat (dua–tiga paragraf statis), daftar tim (nama + peran, tanpa foto), tautan kembali ke Beranda | PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami |
| Halaman Kontak | Form nama/email/pesan; pesan sukses di halaman yang sama; error per field, isi form tidak hilang | PRD §Halaman Kontak |
| File konfigurasi konten | Sumber konten statis (nama organisasi, layanan, tim); isi placeholder, diganti tim sendiri | PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Open questions |

**Tech stack (Web Frontend)**: tidak dinyatakan di PRD — dicatat sebagai OQ-AR-6 (resolved dari manifest repo).

### Backend

| Component | Purpose | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Handler kirim pesan | Validasi sisi server tiga field, simpan ke `contact_messages` beserta `created_at` | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |
| Tabel `contact_messages` | Menyimpan pesan pengunjung; dibaca admin langsung via database | PRD §Data model · §Tujuan |

Lokasi tabel (database upstream vs database baru di aplikasi) belum ditentukan PRD — OQ-AR-1.

### Integrations

Tidak ada integrasi eksternal di rilis ini (PRD §Latar belakang).

### API contracts

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose | Auth | Errors | Source |
|----------|--------|---------|------|--------|--------|
| TBD — OQ-AR-2 | TBD — OQ-AR-2 | Terima `name`, `email`, `message`; validasi sisi server; simpan ke `contact_messages` | Tanpa login (publik) | Error validasi per field (`name` / `email` / `message`) | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |

### Sources

- PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Halaman Kontak · §Data model · §Alur

### Out of Scope

- UI admin, panel admin, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup · §Tujuan).
- Foto anggota tim (PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami).

## Decisions

### D-001: Semua halaman publik tanpa login

Situs ditujukan untuk pengunjung umum. **Decision**: Beranda, Tentang Kami, dan Kontak (termasuk kirim form) bisa diakses tanpa autentikasi. **Consequences**: tidak ada sesi pengguna; proteksi route aplikasi perlu pengecualian khusus untuk tiga halaman ini. **Source**: PRD §Latar belakang ("Tidak ada login") · §Ruang lingkup.

### D-002: Konten statis dari file konfigurasi, bukan CMS

Konten jarang berubah dan CMS di luar lingkup. **Decision**: nama organisasi, layanan, dan tim diambil dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri. **Consequences**: ubah konten = ubah file + deploy ulang. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Ruang lingkup · §Open questions.

### D-003: Validasi di server, hasil tampil di halaman yang sama

**Decision**: form Kontak divalidasi di sisi server; valid → simpan ke `contact_messages` dan tampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; tidak valid → error per field dan isi form tetap. **Consequences**: aturan validasi berlaku di server, bukan hanya di browser. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001.

### D-004: Tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini

**Decision**: admin membaca pesan langsung dari database. **Consequences**: tidak ada halaman daftar pesan, tidak ada notifikasi. **Source**: PRD §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup.

| OQ-FL-1 | Teks pesan error per field | business | low | needs review — conservative default |
| OQ-CN-1 | Proteksi spam form publik | business | low | needs review — conservative default |
| OQ-CN-3 | Syarat responsif untuk semua halaman | business | low | needs review — conservative default |

### Auto-deferred (project_scale: xs)

- OQ-AR-1 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); lokasi tabel `contact_messages`.

## `_meta/modules.yaml` schema

```yaml
mega_sdd_schema: 1
modules:
  - id: <kebab-case identifier with M- prefix>     # e.g., M-auth, M-leave-mgmt, M-reporting
    name: <human-readable display name>             # e.g., "Authentication & Authorization"
    description: <1-2 sentences>                    # optional
    vault_sections:                                  # which vault sections this module covers
      - <vault-file>#<anchor>                       # e.g., flows.md#F-U-001-login
      - <vault-file>#<section-name>
    dod:                                             # Definition of Done (module-level)
      - <checklist item>                            # e.g., "All auth flows return RFC 7807 errors"
      - <test command>                              # e.g., "phpunit tests/Feature/Auth*.php passing"
    estimated_units: <range>                         # e.g., "5-8" — optional sizing hint
    priority: P0 | P1 | P2 | P3
    blocks: []                                       # module IDs that depend on this one
    blocked_by: []                                   # module IDs this one depends on
```

5	import { authOptions } from './libs/auth'
6	
7	export async function proxy(request: Request) {
8	  const session = await getServerSession(authOptions)
9	  const { pathname } = new URL(request.url)
10	
11	  const publicRoutes = ['/login', '/register']
12	  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.includes(pathname)
13	
14	  if (session?.error === 'RefreshTokenError') {
15	    // Clear the session cookie and redirect — no signOut() needed here
16	    const response = NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
17	
18	    response.cookies.delete('next-auth.session-token')
19	    response.cookies.delete('__Secure-next-auth.session-token') // for HTTPS
20	
21	    return response
22	  }
23	
24	  if (session?.accessToken && isPublicRoute) {
25	    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/home', request.url))
26	  }
27	
28	  if (!session?.accessToken && !isPublicRoute) {
29	    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
30	  }
31	
32	  return NextResponse.next()
33	}

      proposed_additional_assertion: "it(\"does not open near-miss paths like /kontak-palsu or nested /kontak/x\") — asserts isOpenRoute returns false for prefix/substring collisions with each of the three open routes, not just unrelated paths."
    - scenario: "The new open-route short-circuit is placed ahead of (or otherwise bypasses) the existing RefreshTokenError branch, so a signed-in user whose session has session.error === 'RefreshTokenError' hitting /beranda gets NextResponse.next() instead of being redirected to /login with cookies cleared — breaking the hard rule 'MUST keep ... the RefreshTokenError redirect unchanged.'"
      missed_by_assertion: "\"lets an anonymous visitor through on an open route\" and \"does not redirect a signed-in user away from an open route\" only mock a null session and a normal valid session respectively — neither exercises session?.error === 'RefreshTokenError' combined with an open-route pathname; \"still redirects an anonymous visitor on a protected route to /login\" only covers the protected-route case."
      proposed_additional_assertion: "it(\"still redirects to /login and clears cookies when a RefreshTokenError session hits an open route\") — mocks getServerSession to resolve { error: 'RefreshTokenError' }, calls proxy on /beranda, and asserts the response redirects to /login with both session cookies deleted."
    - scenario: "proxy.ts derives pathname via `new URL(request.url).pathname`, which is not basePath-stripped the way NextRequest.nextUrl.pathname is; with BASEPATH set (per CLAUDE.md's opt-in BASEPATH env var), the real incoming pathname for the home page is e.g. '/mybase/beranda', so isOpenRoute('/beranda') never matches and the 'no login required' feature silently breaks in any environment that sets BASEPATH."
      missed_by_assertion: "All three proxy() tests (3, 4, 5) construct requests against bare paths ('/beranda', '/login', etc.) with no BASEPATH configured, so none would catch pathname mismatches caused by a basePath prefix."
      proposed_additional_assertion: "it(\"still recognizes an open route when NEXT basePath/BASEPATH prefixes the pathname\") — sets process.env.BASEPATH (or constructs the request URL with a base-path prefix) and asserts an anonymous visitor on the prefixed open-route path is still let through, not redirected."
  coverage_verdict: weak
```

# Unit U-001 — Buat konten statis profil dan Halaman Beranda

## Goal

Membuat file konfigurasi konten profil (placeholder) dan Halaman Beranda di `/beranda` yang menampilkan judul organisasi, tagline, tiga layanan utama, dan tombol menuju Kontak.

## Context (read first)

PRD §Halaman Beranda meminta judul organisasi, tagline satu kalimat, ringkasan tiga layanan (judul + satu paragraf, statis dari file konfigurasi), dan tombol ke Kontak, responsif di 375px dan desktop; binding C-AR-01/C-AR-04 mencatat semuanya sebagai pekerjaan baru. OQ-AR-4 memutuskan konten tinggal di satu modul TypeScript bertipe `src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts`, dan OQ-AR-5 memutuskan URL `/beranda` tanpa mengubah pengalihan `/` → `/home`. Halaman ditaruh di route group `(blank-layout-pages)` yang sudah dipakai `/login` dan `/register` untuk halaman tanpa login; membuka route-nya di route guard adalah pekerjaan U-003.

## Anchors

- src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/layout.tsx:12 — layout route group tanpa login (Providers + BlankLayout); halaman baru cukup jadi `page.tsx` di dalam grup ini
- src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/login/page.tsx:1 — halaman lain di grup yang sama; ikuti bentuk default export page-nya
- src/configs/themeConfig.ts:52 — pola modul konfigurasi statis bertipe di `src/configs/`

## Hard rules

- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
- DO NOT modify next.config.ts
- file src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts MUST exist after bolt
- MUST read the organization name, tagline, and services from src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts instead of hard-coding them in the page (constitution C-001)
- MUST keep the Beranda layout usable at 375px wide and on desktop without horizontal scrolling (PRD §Halaman Beranda, C-CN-07)

## Anti-patterns

- Jangan menaruh Beranda di `/` atau mengubah pengalihan `/` → `/home` (OQ-AR-5, next.config.ts:8).
- Jangan menambah CMS, multi-bahasa, atau autentikasi untuk konten ini (constitution D-001).

## Implementation steps

Pertama buat `src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts` sebagai modul bertipe (misalnya tipe `CompanyProfileConfig`) yang memuat `organizationName`, `tagline`, tepat tiga `services` (masing-masing `title` + `description`), `about.paragraphs` (dua sampai tiga paragraf untuk Tentang Kami), dan `team` (daftar `name` + `role`, tanpa foto) — semua isinya placeholder yang jelas terbaca sebagai contoh supaya tim bisa menggantinya sendiri, dan buat tipe `services` sebagai tuple tiga elemen agar jumlahnya dijaga oleh TypeScript. Lalu buat `src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/beranda/page.tsx` yang membaca konfigurasi itu dan merender judul organisasi sebagai heading utama, tagline, tiga kartu layanan, serta tombol berlabel Kontak yang menaut ke `/kontak` lewat `next/link`; susun dengan komponen MUI responsif (misalnya `Container` + `Grid`/`Stack`) supaya kartu menumpuk di 375px dan berjajar di desktop. Terakhir tulis `page.test.tsx` dengan `renderWithProviders` dari `src/test/utils.tsx`, memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`, termasuk satu test yang me-`vi.mock` modul konfigurasi dengan nilai lain untuk membuktikan halaman tidak menulis teks secara hard-code.

## Acceptance criteria

Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
- TBD: OQ-CN-3 — apakah syarat responsif juga berlaku untuk halaman lain belum diputuskan; di unit ini hanya Beranda yang wajib responsif.

## Out of scope

- Halaman Tentang Kami (U-002).
- Membuka `/beranda` di route guard `src/proxy.ts` (U-003).
- Form dan Halaman Kontak (U-004, U-005).

# Unit U-005 — Buat Halaman Kontak dengan form kirim pesan

## Goal

Membuat Halaman Kontak di `/kontak` dengan form nama/email/pesan yang mengirim ke `POST /api/v1/contact-messages`, menampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama, dan menampilkan error per field tanpa menghapus isi form.

## Context (read first)

Ini sisi browser dari F-U-001 (flows.md): pengunjung mengisi tiga field, klik Kirim, lalu melihat "Pesan terkirim" atau error per field dengan isi form tetap (PRD §Halaman Kontak, §Alur). Route server beserta skema zod dibuat U-004 (OQ-AR-2), dan unit ini memakai skema yang sama untuk validasi instan di browser sambil tetap mengandalkan validasi server. Alur data mengikuti pola rumah: page → hook → repository → `apiClient` → proxy `/api/v1/*`.

## Anchors

- src/features/users/components/UserFormDialog.tsx:64 — pola `useForm` + `zodResolver` + `Controller` dengan `error`/`helperText` per field (baris 131–154)
- src/features/branches/repositories/branch.repository.ts:9 — pola fungsi repository yang memanggil `apiClient` dengan path `/v1/...`
- src/test/utils.tsx:36 — `renderWithProviders` untuk test komponen (Query + Snackbar provider)
- src/test/handlers.ts:49 — pola handler MSW untuk `POST /api/v1/...`

## Hard rules

- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
- DO NOT modify src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts
- MUST use react-hook-form with zodResolver and the shared schema from src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts (constitution A-001)
- MUST give every form field a visible label and keep the whole form operable by keyboard (constitution A-003)
- NEVER render visitor input as raw HTML (constitution B-002)
- MUST call the API only through src/libs/api/client.ts and the /api/v1/contact-messages proxy route (constitution C-002)

## Anti-patterns

- Jangan memakai `enqueueSnackbar` untuk pesan sukses: route group `(blank-layout-pages)` tidak memasang `SnackbarProvider` (src/components/Providers.tsx:27), dan PRD minta pesan sukses di halaman yang sama.
- Jangan membuat skema validasi kedua di form; pakai skema U-004 supaya aturan browser dan server tidak berbeda (constitution A-001, B-001).

## Implementation steps

Mulai dari `src/features/contact/repositories/contact.repository.ts` dengan fungsi `sendContactMessage(payload)` yang memanggil `apiClient.post('/v1/contact-messages', payload)` seperti pola repository branches, lalu bungkus di `src/features/contact/hooks/useContactMessage.ts` sebagai `useMutation` TanStack Query tanpa snackbar. Kemudian buat `src/features/contact/components/ContactForm/index.tsx` sebagai Client Component (`'use client'`) yang memakai `useForm` + `zodResolver(contactMessageSchema)` dengan tiga `TextField` MUI berlabel (Nama, Email, Pesan — pesan multiline), menampilkan error tiap field lewat `error`/`helperText`, dan setelah mutasi sukses menampilkan `Alert` berisi "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; saat server menolak, tampilkan pesan dari error yang dilempar `apiClient` dan jangan reset form. ## Acceptance criteria

Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).

- TBD: OQ-FL-2 — perilaku saat penyimpanan gagal di server belum diputuskan; minimal: isi form tetap dan pesan dari server ditampilkan.

## Out of scope

- Membuka `/kontak` di route guard `src/proxy.ts` (U-003).

# Unit U-005 — Buat Halaman Kontak dengan form kirim pesan

## Goal

Membuat Halaman Kontak di `/kontak` dengan form nama/email/pesan yang mengirim ke `POST /api/v1/contact-messages`, menampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama, dan menampilkan error per field tanpa menghapus isi form.

## Context (read first)

Ini sisi browser dari F-U-001 (flows.md): pengunjung mengisi tiga field, klik Kirim, lalu melihat "Pesan terkirim" atau error per field dengan isi form tetap (PRD §Halaman Kontak, §Alur). Route server beserta skema zod dibuat U-004 (OQ-AR-2), dan unit ini memakai skema yang sama untuk validasi instan di browser sambil tetap mengandalkan validasi server. Alur data mengikuti pola rumah: page → hook → repository → `apiClient` → proxy `/api/v1/*`.

## Anchors

- src/features/users/components/UserFormDialog.tsx:64 — pola `useForm` + `zodResolver` + `Controller` dengan `error`/`helperText` per field (baris 131–154)
- src/features/branches/repositories/branch.repository.ts:9 — pola fungsi repository yang memanggil `apiClient` dengan path `/v1/...`
- src/test/utils.tsx:36 — `renderWithProviders` untuk test komponen (Query + Snackbar provider)
- src/test/handlers.ts:49 — pola handler MSW untuk `POST /api/v1/...`

## Hard rules

- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
- DO NOT modify src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts
- MUST use react-hook-form with zodResolver and the shared schema from src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts (constitution A-001)
- MUST give every form field a visible label and keep the whole form operable by keyboard (constitution A-003)
- NEVER render visitor input as raw HTML (constitution B-002)
- MUST call the API only through src/libs/api/client.ts and the /api/v1/contact-messages proxy route (constitution C-002)

## Anti-patterns

- Jangan memakai `enqueueSnackbar` untuk pesan sukses: route group `(blank-layout-pages)` tidak memasang `SnackbarProvider` (src/components/Providers.tsx:27), dan PRD minta pesan sukses di halaman yang sama.
- Jangan membuat skema validasi kedua di form; pakai skema U-004 supaya aturan browser dan server tidak berbeda (constitution A-001, B-001).

## Implementation steps

Mulai dari `src/features/contact/repositories/contact.repository.ts` dengan fungsi `sendContactMessage(payload)` yang memanggil `apiClient.post('/v1/contact-messages', payload)` seperti pola repository branches, lalu bungkus di `src/features/contact/hooks/useContactMessage.ts` sebagai `useMutation` TanStack Query tanpa snackbar. Kemudian buat `src/features/contact/components/ContactForm/index.tsx` sebagai Client Component (`'use client'`) yang memakai `useForm` + `zodResolver(contactMessageSchema)` dengan tiga `TextField` MUI berlabel (Nama, Email, Pesan — pesan multiline), menampilkan error tiap field lewat `error`/`helperText`, dan setelah mutasi sukses menampilkan `Alert` berisi "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; saat server menolak, tampilkan pesan dari error yang dilempar `apiClient` dan jangan reset form. Terakhir buat `src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/kontak/page.tsx` yang merender heading halaman dan `ContactForm`, lalu tulis `index.test.tsx` dengan `renderWithProviders` dan `server.use(http.post('http://localhost:3000/api/v1/contact-messages', …))` dari `src/test/handlers.ts`, memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`.

## Acceptance criteria

Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
- TBD: OQ-FL-1 — teks error final per field belum diberikan PRD; pakai teks dari skema U-004 yang menyebut field dan aturannya, tanpa menambah salinan baru.
- TBD: OQ-FL-2 — perilaku saat penyimpanan gagal di server belum diputuskan; minimal: isi form tetap dan pesan dari server ditampilkan.

## Out of scope

- Skema validasi dan route server (U-004).
- Membuka `/kontak` di route guard `src/proxy.ts` (U-003).
- Proteksi spam dan retensi data (OQ-CN-1, OQ-CN-2 — masih terbuka).

# Unit U-003 — Buka tiga halaman profil untuk pengunjung tanpa login

## Goal

Membuat `/beranda`, `/tentang-kami`, dan `/kontak` bisa dibuka tanpa login — dan tetap bisa dibuka oleh pengguna yang sedang login — tanpa melonggarkan proteksi route lain.

## Context (read first)

Keputusan D-001 dan PRD §Ruang lingkup menyatakan situs ini tanpa autentikasi, sedangkan route guard `src/proxy.ts` saat ini mengalihkan setiap pengunjung tanpa sesi ke `/login` dan memakai daftar `publicRoutes` yang juga mengalihkan pengguna yang sudah login ke `/home` (binding C-DC-01, OQ-AR-3). Karena itu tiga halaman ini butuh daftar "route terbuka" tersendiri, bukan ditambahkan ke `publicRoutes`. URL-nya diputuskan di OQ-AR-5; route API `/api/v1/contact-messages` sudah dikecualikan oleh `matcher` sehingga tidak perlu diubah.

## Anchors

- src/proxy.ts:11 — daftar `publicRoutes` dan pengecekan `isPublicRoute` (baris 11–12)
- src/proxy.ts:14 — cabang `RefreshTokenError` yang harus tetap berjalan lebih dulu
- src/proxy.ts:24 — pengguna login di `publicRoutes` dialihkan ke `/home`; perilaku ini tidak boleh berlaku untuk route terbuka
- src/proxy.ts:28 — pengunjung anonim di route lain dialihkan ke `/login`
- next.config.ts:8 — pengalihan `/` → `/home` yang tidak disentuh

## Claims

- C-U003-01 "route guard proxy memakai allow-list publicRoutes untuk /login dan /register" — expect: src/proxy.ts:proxy
- C-U003-02 "belum ada modul daftar route terbuka" — expect: src/libs/public-routes/index.ts — must-not-exist
- C-U003-03 "pengalihan / ke /home dikonfigurasi di next.config.ts" — expect: next.config.ts — must-exist

## Hard rules

- DO NOT modify next.config.ts
- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
- file src/libs/public-routes/index.ts MUST exist after bolt
- NEVER open any route other than /beranda, /tentang-kami and /kontak (constitution B-004)
- MUST keep the existing /login and /register handling and the RefreshTokenError redirect unchanged (constitution B-004)

## Anti-patterns

- Jangan menambahkan tiga route ini ke `publicRoutes`: daftar itu mengalihkan pengguna login ke `/home` (src/proxy.ts:24), padahal "publik" di D-001 berarti bisa dibuka tanpa login, bukan hanya untuk tamu.
- Jangan mencocokkan dengan `startsWith`/substring; hanya path persis yang dibuka (constitution B-004).

## Implementation steps

Buat `src/libs/public-routes/index.ts` yang mengekspor daftar tetap `OPEN_ROUTES = ['/beranda', '/tentang-kami', '/kontak']` dan fungsi `isOpenRoute(pathname: string): boolean` yang hanya mencocokkan path persis sama. Lalu ubah `src/proxy.ts` seminimal mungkin: setelah cabang `RefreshTokenError` (baris 14) dan sebelum cabang pengguna login di `publicRoutes` (baris 24), tambahkan pengecekan `isOpenRoute(pathname)` yang langsung mengembalikan `NextResponse.next()`, sehingga pengunjung anonim dan pengguna login sama-sama lolos di tiga route itu sementara semua perilaku lain tetap persis seperti sekarang. Terakhir tulis `src/libs/public-routes/index.test.ts` yang menguji `isOpenRoute` secara langsung dan juga memanggil `proxy` dari `@/proxy` dengan `vi.mock('next-auth', …)` untuk mengatur hasil `getServerSession` (null, sesi valid, dan sesi dengan `error: 'RefreshTokenError'`), memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`.

## Acceptance criteria

Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
- Catatan review adversarial: gap "path berprefiks BASEPATH" TIDAK digabung. `src/proxy.ts:9` sudah membandingkan `new URL(request.url).pathname` untuk `/login` dan `/register`, jadi dukungan BASEPATH adalah perilaku yang sudah ada untuk semua route; mengubahnya di sini melanggar Hard rule "keep existing handling unchanged" (constitution B-004).

## Out of scope

- Halaman Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak itu sendiri (U-001, U-002, U-005).
- Perubahan cara `src/proxy.ts` membaca pathname atau dukungan BASEPATH (lihat catatan di atas).
