// Next Imports
import Link from 'next/link'

import type { Metadata } from 'next'

// MUI Imports
import Avatar from '@mui/material/Avatar'
import Box from '@mui/material/Box'
import Button from '@mui/material/Button'
import Card from '@mui/material/Card'
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent'
import Container from '@mui/material/Container'
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid'
import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack'
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography'

// Config Imports
import companyProfileConfig from '@configs/companyProfileConfig'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Beranda',
  description: companyProfileConfig.tagline
}

const BerandaPage = () => {
  const { organizationName, tagline, services } = companyProfileConfig

  return (
    <Box component='main' sx={{ minBlockSize: '100dvh', overflowX: 'hidden', py: { xs: 8, md: 16 } }}>
      <Container maxWidth='lg'>
        {/* Hero: organization identity and the primary call to action */}
        <Stack spacing={4} sx={{ maxInlineSize: 720, mb: { xs: 10, md: 14 } }}>
          <Typography
            component='h1'
            color='text.primary'
            sx={{ typography: { xs: 'h3', md: 'h2' }, overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}
          >
            {organizationName}
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant='h6' component='p' color='text.secondary' sx={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
            {tagline}
          </Typography>
          <Box>
            <Button
              component={Link}
              href='/kontak'
              variant='contained'
              size='large'
              endIcon={<i className='tabler-arrow-right' aria-hidden='true' />}
              sx={{ inlineSize: { xs: '100%', sm: 'auto' } }}
            >
              Kontak
            </Button>
          </Box>
        </Stack>

        {/* Services: stacked on small screens, three across from md upward */}
        <Stack component='section' aria-labelledby='beranda-layanan-heading' spacing={6}>
          <Typography id='beranda-layanan-heading' variant='h4' component='h2'>
            Layanan Kami
          </Typography>
          <Grid container spacing={6} component='ul' aria-label='Layanan' sx={{ listStyle: 'none', p: 0, m: 0 }}>
            {services.map((service, index) => (
              <Grid key={service.title} component='li' size={{ xs: 12, md: 4 }}>
                <Card sx={{ blockSize: '100%' }}>
                  <CardContent>
                    <Stack spacing={3}>
                      <Avatar
                        variant='rounded'
                        aria-hidden='true'
                        sx={{ bgcolor: 'primary.main', color: 'primary.contrastText', fontWeight: 600 }}
                      >
                        {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                      </Avatar>
                      <Typography variant='h5' component='h3' sx={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                        {service.title}
                      </Typography>
                      <Typography component='p' color='text.secondary' sx={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                        {service.description}
                      </Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>
            ))}
          </Grid>
        </Stack>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  )
}

export default BerandaPage

54	# Unit U-003 — Buka tiga halaman profil untuk pengunjung tanpa login
55	
56	## Goal
57	
58	Membuat `/beranda`, `/tentang-kami`, dan `/kontak` bisa dibuka tanpa login — dan tetap bisa dibuka oleh pengguna yang sedang login — tanpa melonggarkan proteksi route lain.
59	
60	## Context (read first)
61	
62	Keputusan D-001 dan PRD §Ruang lingkup menyatakan situs ini tanpa autentikasi, sedangkan route guard `src/proxy.ts` saat ini mengalihkan setiap pengunjung tanpa sesi ke `/login` dan memakai daftar `publicRoutes` yang juga mengalihkan pengguna yang sudah login ke `/home` (binding C-DC-01, OQ-AR-3). Karena itu tiga halaman ini butuh daftar "route terbuka" tersendiri, bukan ditambahkan ke `publicRoutes`. URL-nya diputuskan di OQ-AR-5; route API `/api/v1/contact-messages` sudah dikecualikan oleh `matcher` sehingga tidak perlu diubah.
63	
64	## Anchors
65	
66	- src/proxy.ts:11 — daftar `publicRoutes` dan pengecekan `isPublicRoute` (baris 11–12)
67	- src/proxy.ts:14 — cabang `RefreshTokenError` yang harus tetap berjalan lebih dulu
68	- src/proxy.ts:24 — pengguna login di `publicRoutes` dialihkan ke `/home`; perilaku ini tidak boleh berlaku untuk route terbuka
69	- src/proxy.ts:28 — pengunjung anonim di route lain dialihkan ke `/login`
70	- next.config.ts:8 — pengalihan `/` → `/home` yang tidak disentuh
71	
72	## Claims
73	
74	- C-U003-01 "route guard proxy memakai allow-list publicRoutes untuk /login dan /register" — expect: src/proxy.ts:proxy
75	- C-U003-02 "belum ada modul daftar route terbuka" — expect: src/libs/public-routes/index.ts — must-not-exist
76	- C-U003-03 "pengalihan / ke /home dikonfigurasi di next.config.ts" — expect: next.config.ts — must-exist
77	
78	## Hard rules
79	
80	- DO NOT modify next.config.ts
81	  Source: constraints.md OQ-AR-5 (Resolved v1.1 — pengalihan / → /home tidak diubah)
82	- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
83	  Source: binding.md §Suggested Unit Hard Rules (DO NOT modify package.json — C-MODE-01, C-AR-08); allowed_new_deps: []
84	- file src/libs/public-routes/index.ts MUST exist after bolt
85	  Source: binding.md §Anti-patterns (src/proxy.ts:24 — exempt the pages without inheriting the login-page bounce)
86	- NEVER open any route other than /beranda, /tentang-kami and /kontak (constitution B-004)
87	  Source: constitution.md B-004; constraints.md OQ-AR-5
88	- MUST keep the existing /login and /register handling and the RefreshTokenError redirect unchanged (constitution B-004)
89	  Source: constitution.md B-004; binding.md C-DC-01
90	
91	## Anti-patterns
92	
93	- Jangan menambahkan tiga route ini ke `publicRoutes`: daftar itu mengalihkan pengguna login ke `/home` (src/proxy.ts:24), padahal "publik" di D-001 berarti bisa dibuka tanpa login, bukan hanya untuk tamu.
94	- Jangan mencocokkan dengan `startsWith`/substring; hanya path persis yang dibuka (constitution B-004).
95	
96	## Implementation steps
97	
98	Buat `src/libs/public-routes/index.ts` yang mengekspor daftar tetap `OPEN_ROUTES = ['/beranda', '/tentang-kami', '/kontak']` dan fungsi `isOpenRoute(pathname: string): boolean` yang hanya mencocokkan path persis sama. Lalu ubah `src/proxy.ts` seminimal mungkin: setelah cabang `RefreshTokenError` (baris 14) dan sebelum cabang pengguna login di `publicRoutes` (baris 24), tambahkan pengecekan `isOpenRoute(pathname)` yang langsung mengembalikan `NextResponse.next()`, sehingga pengunjung anonim dan pengguna login sama-sama lolos di tiga route itu sementara semua perilaku lain tetap persis seperti sekarang. Terakhir tulis `src/libs/public-routes/index.test.ts` yang menguji `isOpenRoute` secara langsung dan juga memanggil `proxy` dari `@/proxy` dengan `vi.mock('next-auth', …)` untuk mengatur hasil `getServerSession` (null, sesi valid, dan sesi dengan `error: 'RefreshTokenError'`), memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`.
99	
100	## Acceptance criteria
101	
102	Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
103	
104	- Catatan review adversarial: gap "path berprefiks BASEPATH" TIDAK digabung. `src/proxy.ts:9` sudah membandingkan `new URL(request.url).pathname` untuk `/login` dan `/register`, jadi dukungan BASEPATH adalah perilaku yang sudah ada untuk semua route; mengubahnya di sini melanggar Hard rule "keep existing handling unchanged" (constitution B-004).
105	
106	## Out of scope
107	
108	- Halaman Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak itu sendiri (U-001, U-002, U-005).
109	- Perubahan cara `src/proxy.ts` membaca pathname atau dukungan BASEPATH (lihat catatan di atas).

23	  const { pathname } = new URL(request.url)

41	    return NextResponse.next()
42	  }
43	
44	  if (session?.accessToken && isPublicRoute) {
45	    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/home', request.url))
46	  }
47	
48	  if (!session?.accessToken && !isPublicRoute) {
49	    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
50	  }
51	
52	  return NextResponse.next()
53	}

70	
71	## Goal
72	
73	Membuat skema zod pesan kontak dan route publik `POST /api/v1/contact-messages` yang memvalidasi di server lalu meneruskan pesan valid ke upstream `POST /v1/contact-messages`.
74	
75	## Context (read first)
76	
77	F-U-001 (flows.md) dan PRD §Halaman Kontak meminta validasi sisi server untuk nama (wajib, ≤100), email (wajib, format valid) dan pesan (wajib, ≤2000), dengan batas email ≤255 dari model.md; binding C-AR-05/C-DM-01 mencatat semuanya sebagai pekerjaan baru. OQ-AR-1 memutuskan tabel `contact_messages` (termasuk `created_at`) tinggal di layanan upstream sehingga aplikasi ini tidak menyimpan apa pun, dan OQ-AR-2 memutuskan alamatnya `POST /api/v1/contact-messages` → upstream `POST /v1/contact-messages`. Skema ini juga dipakai ulang oleh form di U-005.
78	
79	## Anchors
80	
81	- src/app/api/v1/users/route.ts:4 — contoh route proxy `POST` satu baris dengan `proxyPost`
82	- src/libs/api/route-handler.ts:43 — `proxyPost` membaca `req.json()` lalu meneruskan lewat `apiServer.post` (baris 43–50) dan memetakan `success:false` ke HTTP 400 (baris 19–21)
83	- src/features/users/schemas/user.schema.ts:3 — pola file skema: schema + tipe inferred + nilai default (baris 3–30)
84	- src/test/handlers.ts:49 — pola handler MSW `POST` untuk menangkap body yang diteruskan
85

87	
88	- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
89	  Source: constraints.md OQ-AR-1 (Resolved v1.1 — tanpa database atau ORM baru); allowed_new_deps: []

95	  Source: constitution.md B-001

97	  Source: constitution.md C-002

99	  Source: constraints.md OQ-AR-1 (Resolved v1.1)
100	
101	## Anti-patterns
102	
103	- Jangan meneruskan body mentah dari browser ke upstream; hanya `name`, `email`, `message` yang sudah tervalidasi (constitution B-001).
104	- Jangan menulis try/catch + `apiServer` manual untuk penerusan ke upstream; pakai `proxyPost` (constitution C-002).
105	
106	## Implementation steps
107	
108	Pertama buat `src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts` mengikuti pola `user.schema.ts`: `contactMessageSchema` dengan `name` string yang di-trim, wajib dan maksimal 100 karakter, `email` yang di-trim, wajib, berformat email dan maksimal 255 karakter, serta `message` yang di-trim, wajib dan maksimal 2000 karakter; ekspor juga tipe `ContactMessageValues` hasil `z.infer` dan `contactMessageDefaults`, dengan pesan error pendek yang menyebut field dan aturannya. 121	- Proteksi spam dan retensi data (OQ-CN-1, OQ-CN-2 — masih terbuka).

5	export type RequestOptions = RequestInit & {
6	  params?: Record<string, string>
7	}

9	type FetcherConfig = {
10	  baseURL: string
11	
12	  /** Browser uses getSession(); server uses getServerSession(authOptions). */
13	  getSession: () => Promise<Session | null>
14	
15	  /**
16	   * How a non-OK response is handled. The browser fetcher throws (so mutation
17	   * hooks surface the message via onError); the server fetcher returns a
18	   * `{ success: false }` envelope. Either way the return type is the envelope.
19	   */
20	  onError: (res: Response) => Promise<ApiResponse<unknown>>
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * Shared fetcher core for both apiClient (browser) and apiServer (RSC / route
25	 * handlers). The only differences between them — session source and error
26	 * handling — are injected via config; everything else (header building, URL
27	 * building, the verb wrappers) lives here so the two stay in lockstep.
28	 */
29	export function createFetcher({ baseURL, getSession, onError }: FetcherConfig) {
30	  async function getHeaders(customHeaders?: HeadersInit): Promise<HeadersInit> {
31	    const session = await getSession()
32	
33	    return {
34	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
35	      ...(session?.accessToken && {
36	        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`
37	      }),
38	      ...customHeaders
39	    }
40	  }
41	
42	  function buildURL(path: string, params?: Record<string, string>): string {
43	    // apiClient's baseURL is a same-origin relative prefix ('/api'); resolve it
44	    // against the browser origin. apiServer's baseURL is already absolute, so the
45	    // base is ignored there (and window is undefined on the server anyway).
46	    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? undefined : window.location.origin
47	    const url = new URL(`${baseURL}${path}`, base)
48	
49	    if (params) {
50	      Object.entries(params).forEach(([k, v]) => url.searchParams.set(k, v))
51	    }
52	
53	    return url.toString()
54	  }
55	
56	  async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
57	    const { params, headers, ...rest } = options
58	
59	    const res = await fetch(buildURL(path, params), {
60	      ...rest,
61	      headers: await getHeaders(headers)
62	    })
63	
64	    if (!res.ok) {
65	      return onError(res) as Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
66	    }
67	
68	    return res.json() as Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
69	  }
70	
71	  return {
72	    get: <T>(path: string, options?: RequestOptions) => request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'GET' }),
73	    post: <T>(path: string, body: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
74	      request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
75	    put: <T>(path: string, body: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
76	      request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),

3	// Browser fetcher. Calls the same-origin Next.js proxy routes under /api/v1/**
4	// (BASEPATH-aware via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEPATH). It sends NO Authorization header —
5	// the httpOnly next-auth session cookie travels with the same-origin request and
6	// the proxy route attaches the bearer to the upstream call server-side. Throws on
7	// non-OK so mutation hooks surface the message via onError.
8	const BASE_PATH = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEPATH ?? ''
9	
10	export const apiClient = createFetcher({
11	  baseURL: `${BASE_PATH}/api`,
12	  getSession: async () => null,
13	  onError: async res => {
14	    const error = await res.json().catch(() => ({ message: res.statusText }))
15	
16	    throw new Error(error.message ?? 'Something went wrong')
17	  }
18	})

1	import type { Session } from 'next-auth'
2	
3	import type { ApiResponse } from '@/types/common'
4	
5	export type RequestOptions = RequestInit & {
6	  params?: Record<string, string>
7	}
8	
9	type FetcherConfig = {
10	  baseURL: string
11	
12	  /** Browser uses getSession(); server uses getServerSession(authOptions). */
13	  getSession: () => Promise<Session | null>
14	
15	  /**
16	   * How a non-OK response is handled. The browser fetcher throws (so mutation
17	   * hooks surface the message via onError); the server fetcher returns a
18	   * `{ success: false }` envelope. Either way the return type is the envelope.
19	   */
20	  onError: (res: Response) => Promise<ApiResponse<unknown>>
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * Shared fetcher core for both apiClient (browser) and apiServer (RSC / route
25	 * handlers). The only differences between them — session source and error
26	 * handling — are injected via config; everything else (header building, URL
27	 * building, the verb wrappers) lives here so the two stay in lockstep.
28	 */
29	export function createFetcher({ baseURL, getSession, onError }: FetcherConfig) {
30	  async function getHeaders(customHeaders?: HeadersInit): Promise<HeadersInit> {
31	    const session = await getSession()
32	
33	    return {
34	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
35	      ...(session?.accessToken && {
36	        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`
37	      }),
38	      ...customHeaders
39	    }
40	  }
41	
42	  function buildURL(path: string, params?: Record<string, string>): string {
43	    // apiClient's baseURL is a same-origin relative prefix ('/api'); resolve it
44	    // against the browser origin. apiServer's baseURL is already absolute, so the
45	    // base is ignored there (and window is undefined on the server anyway).
46	    const base = typeof window === 'undefined' ? undefined : window.location.origin
47	    const url = new URL(`${baseURL}${path}`, base)
48	
49	    if (params) {
50	      Object.entries(params).forEach(([k, v]) => url.searchParams.set(k, v))
51	    }
52	
53	    return url.toString()
54	  }
55	
56	  async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
57	    const { params, headers, ...rest } = options
58	
59	    const res = await fetch(buildURL(path, params), {
60	      ...rest,
61	      headers: await getHeaders(headers)
62	    })
63	
64	    if (!res.ok) {
65	      return onError(res) as Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
66	    }
67	
68	    return res.json() as Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
69	  }
70	
71	  return {
72	    get: <T>(path: string, options?: RequestOptions) => request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'GET' }),
73	    post: <T>(path: string, body: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
74	      request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
75	    put: <T>(path: string, body: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
76	      request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
77	    delete: <T>(path: string, options?: RequestOptions) => request<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'DELETE' })
78	  }
79	}

**Status: DONE.** The public `/kontak` page and its contact form are built and committed as `41444a99a7504e2a5bdb939dbbc225396897802f` on `bench/p0-company-profile`. All 7 acceptance tests pass, and so does the full suite (62/62). One manual acceptance check still needs a person: keyboard and screen-reader use of `/kontak`.

## What I implemented
- **Page:** `/kontak` has the heading "Kontak" and a form with three labelled fields: Nama, Email and Pesan (multiline). It stacks to one column on small screens and matches the Beranda page's layout.
- **Validation:** the form checks input in the browser with U-004's shared schema, unchanged. Errors show under each field and the values stay filled in.
- **Success:** "Pesan terkirim" appears on the same page and the form clears.
- **Server rejection:** the server's own message is shown and the values are kept.
- **No snackbar:** these public pages have no snackbar provider, so all feedback is inline.
- **Sending:** the form posts to `/api/v1/contact-messages` through `apiClient`.

## Testing
- **Test first:** the acceptance test failed first for the right reason (`Failed to resolve import "./index"`), then passed 7/7.
- **Checks:** `pnpm test:run` passes (9 files, 62 tests), `tsc --noEmit` exits 0, and eslint and prettier are clean on the five files. `pnpm build` succeeds and lists `ƒ /kontak`.
- **Server-rejection test:** it returns the route's real 422 message and checks that exact text appears, so the message is proven to come from the server. It also types markup into Nama and checks that no element gets rendered from it.
- **Coverage limit:** the server-error path is tested for the 422 response only.
- **Still to do (manual):** open `/kontak` logged out, fill and submit the form with the keyboard only, and confirm a screen reader reads every label.

## Hard rules (none violated; checked against the landed commit)
- **No new dependencies:** the commit leaves `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` unchanged.
- **Schema not modified:** the commit leaves `contact.schema.ts` unchanged; the form only imports it.
- **react-hook-form + zodResolver + shared schema:** the form uses `useForm` with `zodResolver(contactMessageSchema)`. There is no second schema.
- **Visible labels and keyboard use:** each field has a `<label for=…>`, and the test checks Tab order Nama → Email → Pesan → Kirim.
- **No raw HTML from visitors:** everything renders as React text, and the commit contains no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` or `innerHTML`.
- **API only through `apiClient` and the proxy:** the only network call is `apiClient.post('/v1/contact-messages', …)`.

## reuse_decisions
- `apiClient`: reused.
- `contactMessageSchema` / `contactMessageDefaults` / `ContactMessageValues`: reused, unmodified.
- `makeCreateMutation`: not_applicable. It always shows snackbars and refreshes a list cache; the unit forbids snackbars here and there is no list to refresh.
- `createQueryKeys`: not_applicable, because nothing is cached.
- `renderWithProviders` and the MSW `server`: reused, with the test-harness files unmodified.
- `companyProfileConfig`: reused for the organization name in the page intro.
- UserFormDialog form pattern: followed, with two changes. The field's `ref` goes to the input so the first invalid field gets focus, and there is no `as any` cast because the types check cleanly.
- `reuse-index.yaml` does not exist, so I searched `symbol-index.json` instead and found no existing contact or mutation helper.

## Judgement calls and limits
- **Form clears after a successful send.** The unit only says not to reset after a server rejection, so this is my call and is logged as an uncertain decision. Undoing it means removing the `onSuccess` reset in `ContactForm/index.tsx`.
- **Extra page elements I added:** a "Kembali ke Beranda" link, an intro sentence using the organization name, and a card heading "Kirim Pesan".
- **Design is medium confidence.** The vault has no design system and the dispatch's design section was truncated, so the page uses theme defaults only, like Beranda. A design system should be raised as an open question.
- **Open question OQ-FL-2:** when the server rejects fields, its per-field errors appear as one message rather than under each field, because `apiClient` passes on only the message. The required minimum (values kept, server message shown) is met.
- **Provenance headers:** the version `v7.34.0` comes from the dispatch's Contracts line, because the Provenance values block has no version key. All other header values are copied exactly from that block.

43	# Unit U-002 — Buat Halaman Tentang Kami
44	
45	## Goal
46	
47	Membuat Halaman Tentang Kami di `/tentang-kami` yang menampilkan profil singkat, daftar tim (nama + peran, tanpa foto), dan tautan kembali ke Beranda.
48	
49	## Context (read first)
50	
51	PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami meminta dua–tiga paragraf profil statis, daftar tim dari konfigurasi tanpa foto, dan tautan kembali ke Beranda; binding C-AR-02 mencatatnya sebagai pekerjaan baru. Kontennya dibaca dari `src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts` yang dibuat U-001 (OQ-AR-4), dan URL-nya `/tentang-kami` (OQ-AR-5), di route group `(blank-layout-pages)` yang sama dengan Beranda.
52	
53	## Anchors
54	
55	- src/components/Providers.tsx:18 — provider (NextAuth, TanStack Query, tema) yang dipasang layout route group halaman ini bersama BlankLayout (layout grupnya tercatat di `existing_interfaces`)
56	
57	## Hard rules
58	
59	- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
60	  Source: binding.md §Suggested Unit Hard Rules (DO NOT modify package.json — C-MODE-01, C-AR-08); allowed_new_deps: []
61	- DO NOT modify src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts
62	  Source: U-001 target_files (file owned by U-001); constraints.md OQ-AR-4 (Resolved v1.1)
63	- MUST read the profile paragraphs and the team list from src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts instead of hard-coding them in the page (constitution C-001)
64	  Source: constitution.md C-001
65	
66	## Anti-patterns
67	
68	- Jangan menampilkan foto anggota tim, termasuk avatar placeholder (constitution D-002, PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami).
69	
70	## Implementation steps
71	
72	Buat `src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/tentang-kami/page.tsx` yang mengimpor konfigurasi dari U-001 lalu merender heading halaman, setiap paragraf di `about.paragraphs` sebagai paragraf terpisah, dan daftar tim yang menampilkan nama serta peran tiap anggota sebagai teks saja, ditambah tautan kembali ke `/beranda` lewat `next/link`. Pakai komponen MUI yang sama gayanya dengan Beranda supaya kedua halaman terasa satu situs. Tulis `page.test.tsx` dengan `renderWithProviders` dari `src/test/utils.tsx` memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`, termasuk satu test yang me-`vi.mock` modul konfigurasi dengan nilai lain untuk membuktikan halaman tidak menulis teks secara hard-code, dan satu test yang memastikan tidak ada elemen `img` untuk anggota tim.
73	
74	## Acceptance criteria
75	
76	Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
77	
78	## Out of scope
79	
80	- Mengubah isi atau bentuk file konfigurasi (milik U-001).
81	- Membuka `/tentang-kami` di route guard `src/proxy.ts` (U-003).

61	# Unit U-005 — Buat Halaman Kontak dengan form kirim pesan
62	
63	## Goal
64	
65	Membuat Halaman Kontak di `/kontak` dengan form nama/email/pesan yang mengirim ke `POST /api/v1/contact-messages`, menampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama, dan menampilkan error per field tanpa menghapus isi form.
66	
67	## Context (read first)
68	
69	Ini sisi browser dari F-U-001 (flows.md): pengunjung mengisi tiga field, klik Kirim, lalu melihat "Pesan terkirim" atau error per field dengan isi form tetap (PRD §Halaman Kontak, §Alur). Route server beserta skema zod dibuat U-004 (OQ-AR-2), dan unit ini memakai skema yang sama untuk validasi instan di browser sambil tetap mengandalkan validasi server. Alur data mengikuti pola rumah: page → hook → repository → `apiClient` → proxy `/api/v1/*`.
70	
71	## Anchors
72	
73	- src/features/users/components/UserFormDialog.tsx:64 — pola `useForm` + `zodResolver` + `Controller` dengan `error`/`helperText` per field (baris 131–154)
74	- src/features/branches/repositories/branch.repository.ts:9 — pola fungsi repository yang memanggil `apiClient` dengan path `/v1/...`
75	- src/test/utils.tsx:36 — `renderWithProviders` untuk test komponen (Query + Snackbar provider)
76	- src/test/handlers.ts:49 — pola handler MSW untuk `POST /api/v1/...`
77	
78	## Hard rules
79	
80	- DO NOT add new package.json dependencies
81	  Source: binding.md §Suggested Unit Hard Rules (DO NOT modify package.json — C-MODE-01, C-AR-08); allowed_new_deps: []
82	- DO NOT modify src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts
83	  Source: U-004 target_files (file owned by U-004)
84	- MUST use react-hook-form with zodResolver and the shared schema from src/features/contact/schemas/contact.schema.ts (constitution A-001)
85	  Source: constitution.md A-001
86	- MUST give every form field a visible label and keep the whole form operable by keyboard (constitution A-003)
87	  Source: constitution.md A-003
88	- NEVER render visitor input as raw HTML (constitution B-002)
89	  Source: constitution.md B-002
90	- MUST call the API only through src/libs/api/client.ts and the /api/v1/contact-messages proxy route (constitution C-002)
91	  Source: constitution.md C-002; constraints.md OQ-AR-2
92	
93	## Anti-patterns
94	
95	- Jangan memakai `enqueueSnackbar` untuk pesan sukses: route group `(blank-layout-pages)` tidak memasang `SnackbarProvider` (src/components/Providers.tsx:27), dan PRD minta pesan sukses di halaman yang sama.
96	- Jangan membuat skema validasi kedua di form; pakai skema U-004 supaya aturan browser dan server tidak berbeda (constitution A-001, B-001).
97	
98	## Implementation steps
99	
100	Mulai dari `src/features/contact/repositories/contact.repository.ts` dengan fungsi `sendContactMessage(payload)` yang memanggil `apiClient.post('/v1/contact-messages', payload)` seperti pola repository branches, lalu bungkus di `src/features/contact/hooks/useContactMessage.ts` sebagai `useMutation` TanStack Query tanpa snackbar. Kemudian buat `src/features/contact/components/ContactForm/index.tsx` sebagai Client Component (`'use client'`) yang memakai `useForm` + `zodResolver(contactMessageSchema)` dengan tiga `TextField` MUI berlabel (Nama, Email, Pesan — pesan multiline), menampilkan error tiap field lewat `error`/`helperText`, dan setelah mutasi sukses menampilkan `Alert` berisi "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; saat server menolak, tampilkan pesan dari error yang dilempar `apiClient` dan jangan reset form. Terakhir buat `src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/kontak/page.tsx` yang merender heading halaman dan `ContactForm`, lalu tulis `index.test.tsx` dengan `renderWithProviders` dan `server.use(http.post('http://localhost:3000/api/v1/contact-messages', …))` dari `src/test/handlers.ts`, memakai nama `it(...)` persis seperti di `acceptance_test`.
101	
102	## Acceptance criteria
103	
104	Acceptance criteria are the frontmatter `acceptance_test:` entries (authoritative).
105	
106	- TBD: OQ-FL-1 — teks error final per field belum diberikan PRD; pakai teks dari skema U-004 yang menyebut field dan aturannya, tanpa menambah salinan baru.
107	- TBD: OQ-FL-2 — perilaku saat penyimpanan gagal di server belum diputuskan; minimal: isi form tetap dan pesan dari server ditampilkan.
108	
109	## Out of scope
110	
111	- Skema validasi dan route server (U-004).
112	- Membuka `/kontak` di route guard `src/proxy.ts` (U-003).
113	- Proteksi spam dan retensi data (OQ-CN-1, OQ-CN-2 — masih terbuka).

3	// Browser fetcher. Calls the same-origin Next.js proxy routes under /api/v1/**
4	// (BASEPATH-aware via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEPATH). It sends NO Authorization header —
5	// the httpOnly next-auth session cookie travels with the same-origin request and
6	// the proxy route attaches the bearer to the upstream call server-side. Throws on
7	// non-OK so mutation hooks surface the message via onError.
8	const BASE_PATH = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEPATH ?? ''
9	
10	export const apiClient = createFetcher({
11	  baseURL: `${BASE_PATH}/api`,
12	  getSession: async () => null,
13	  onError: async res => {
14	    const error = await res.json().catch(() => ({ message: res.statusText }))
15

17	  }

3	// Browser fetcher. Calls the same-origin Next.js proxy routes under /api/v1/**
4	// (BASEPATH-aware via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEPATH). It sends NO Authorization header —
5	// the httpOnly next-auth session cookie travels with the same-origin request and
6	// the proxy route attaches the bearer to the upstream call server-side. Throws on
7	// non-OK so mutation hooks surface the message via onError.

9	
10	export const apiClient = createFetcher({

12	  getSession: async () => null,
13	  onError: async res => {
14	    const error = await res.json().catch(() => ({ message: res.statusText }))
15	
16	    throw new Error(error.message ?? 'Something went wrong')
17	  }
18	})

44

56	    )

import Box from '@mui/material/Box'
import Button from '@mui/material/Button'
import Card from '@mui/material/Card'
import CardContent from '@mui/material/CardContent'
import Container from '@mui/material/Container'

import Stack from '@mui/material/Stack'

  title: 'Tentang Kami',
  description: companyProfileConfig.about.paragraphs[0]
}

  const { organizationName, about, team } = companyProfileConfig

  return (
    <Box component='main' sx={{ minBlockSize: '100dvh', py: { xs: 8, md: 16 } }}>
      <Container maxWidth='lg'>
        {/* Back navigation to the home page */}
        <Box sx={{ mb: { xs: 6, md: 8 } }}>
          <Button
            component={Link}
            href='/beranda'
            variant='text'
            startIcon={<i className='tabler-arrow-left' aria-hidden='true' />}
          >
            Kembali ke Beranda
          </Button>
        </Box>

        {/* Page title and the short organization profile */}
        <Stack spacing={4} sx={{ maxInlineSize: 720, mb: { xs: 10, md: 14 } }}>
          <Stack spacing={1}>
            <Typography variant='overline' component='p' color='primary.main' sx={{ overflowWrap: 'break-word' }}>
              {organizationName}
            </Typography>
            <Typography component='h1' color='text.primary' sx={{ typography: { xs: 'h3', md: 'h2' } }}>
              Tentang Kami
            </Typography>
          </Stack>
          <Stack component='section' aria-label='Profil singkat' spacing={3}>

                {paragraph}

            ))}
          </Stack>
        </Stack>

        {/* Team: names and roles as text only; members are never shown with a photo */}

          <Typography id='tentang-kami-tim-heading' variant='h4' component='h2'>

          <Grid container spacing={6} component='ul' aria-label='Tim' sx={{ listStyle: 'none', p: 0, m: 0 }}>

                <Card sx={{ blockSize: '100%', borderInlineStart: 4, borderColor: 'primary.main' }}>

                        {member.role}
                      </Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </Grid>
            ))}
          </Grid>
        </Stack>
      </Container>
    </Box>
  )
}

- Important | /Users/farhanriuzaki/SunnyGo/2026/AIRND2026/Project/TRAINING/p0-xs-arm/src/features/contact/components/ContactForm/index.test.tsx:113 | Whitespace-only name assertion can never fail | The name field still shows `Nama wajib diisi` from the submit at line 107, so the `waitFor` at line 115 passes on that old text whether or not the schema trims. Fix: give the whitespace case its own `it` with a fresh render, or first set a valid name and wait for the error text to clear, then set `'   '`, submit, and assert.

It is missing where it is needed: `handleSubmit` never calls `onSubmit` on invalid input, so after one successful send, an invalid second submit shows the old success alert next to the new errors. Lens quality untuk U-005 masuk dengan 1 Important dan 3 Minor. Temuan Important-nya: ada assertion untuk nama berisi whitespace saja yang tidak akan pernah gagal, karena memakai sisa teks error dari submit sebelumnya. Salah satu Minor adalah bug UX nyata: alert "Pesan terkirim" masih tampil ketika submit kedua tidak valid.

Menurut gate §Merge, re-dispatch hanya terjadi kalau spec ❌ atau ada Critical. Important dipetakan ke `advisory` oleh `merge-panel-findings.sh`. Jadi tidak ada fix round. Keempat temuan akan dicatat di bolt-report dan `_summary.md` sebagai follow-up, dan verdict akhirnya tetap dari skrip merge.

Langkah berikutnya cuma satu yang independen, yaitu menyimpan return ini ke file input merge. Merge U-005 masih menunggu lens standards dan design.

FINDINGS:
- Important | src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/tentang-kami/page.tsx:58 | Overline eyebrow text fails WCAG AA contrast | `color='primary.main'` (theme `#7367F0`, `src/@core/theme/colorSchemes.ts:12`) as text on `background.default`/`paper` (`#F8F7FA`/`#FFFFFF`, same file:86-87) computes to ≈4.27:1, below the slice's Accessibility/Color Contrast floor (4.5:1 normal text, High severity). This is a new text-on-background usage (Beranda only uses `primary.main` as a filled badge background with `primary.contrastText`, `beranda/page.tsx:89`, so nothing there vouches for it). Fix: use `primary.dark`/`text.secondary` for the eyebrow, or carry emphasis via weight/letter-spacing instead of color.
- Minor | src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/tentang-kami/page.tsx:41 | Missing horizontal-overflow guard present on sibling page | Beranda hardens the shell with `overflowX: 'hidden'` (`beranda/page.tsx:47`) and uses `overflowWrap: 'anywhere'` (`beranda/page.tsx:54,58,93,96`); this page omits `overflowX` and uses the weaker `overflowWrap: 'break-word'` (lines 58, 67, 85, 88), which doesn't affect intrinsic min-content sizing — a long unbroken team member name inside the `Grid`/`Card` could still force horizontal scroll at 375px. Vault fact asks these two pages to feel consistent; align the overflow handling with Beranda.
- Minor | src/app/(blank-layout-pages)/layout.tsx:24 (cross-unit, shared `BlankLayout` shell) | Public pages have no shared header/nav — page furniture is shell-level, not this unit's | `beranda`, `tentang-kami`, `kontak` mount into `BlankLayout` with no header/nav; inter-page discovery is only the one-way "Kembali ke Beranda" button this unit correctly ships, plus Beranda's one-way link to `/kontak` — nothing links to `/tentang-kami`. `modern-baseline.md §Ceiling moves` lists page furniture first; this is a thin shell across all three public pages, not a defect unique to this unit's page. Flag for a future shell-level unit rather than blocking this bolt.

CHECKED-CLEAN: token discipline (theme tokens only — `text.primary`/`text.secondary`/`primary.main` via `sx`, zero raw hex/px), spacing rhythm (MUI spacing scale throughout), typographic scale (`overline`/responsive `h2`-`h3`/`h4`/`h5` with a real pairing, not a system wall), page shell (mounts in `BlankLayout` + `Container maxWidth='lg'`), composition (multi-section: back-nav → hero-style title/profile → responsive team grid, not a lone card), semantics/landmarks (`main`, named `section`s via aria-label/aria-labelledby, `ul`/`li` roles, h1→h2→h3 order), responsive grid (`xs:12 / sm:6 / md:4`), no anti-kuno tells, no team photos or placeholder avatars per D-002 (verified in tests too), icon (`tabler-arrow-left`) already bundled in `generated-icons.css`, config read-only per C-001 (companyProfileConfig.ts untouched by this diff). #!/usr/bin/env bash
# compute-unit-staleness.sh — deterministic unit staleness for the living-vault
# sync lane (spec 2026-06-10-living-vault-continuous-sync-design.md, slice S6).
#
# For every unit with a committed bolt (bolt-report.md carrying target_hashes:),
# compare each recorded sha256 to the current working tree:
#   - any hash differs OR file missing  → stale
#   - all hashes match                  → implemented
#   - bolt-report absent or no target_hashes field → unknown (legacy; never guessed)
# `superseded` is NOT computed here — that requires binding/vault knowledge and is
# assigned by generate-units --reconcile when a claim vanishes.
#
# Usage:
#   compute-unit-staleness.sh --vault=<vault-dir> [--project=<repo-root>]
# Output: JSON on stdout. Exit 0 always (staleness is data); exit 2 on bad invocation.
    --vault=*) VAULT="${arg#*=}" ;;
    --project=*) PROJECT="${arg#*=}" ;;
[ -n "$VAULT" ] && [ -d "$VAULT" ] || { echo "--vault=<dir> required (must exist)" >&2; exit 2; }

Base directory for this skill: /Users/farhanriuzaki/.claude/plugins/cache/mega-sdd/mega-sdd/7.34.0/skills/detect-drift

# Drift Detect — vault vs live codebase reconciliation

> **Forked, non-interactive (token-reset pilot, `context: fork`).** This skill runs as a forked subagent with no conversation history, so it **NEVER calls `AskUserQuestion`** — the former `--auto` behavior is now the *only* behavior. It detects + reports + queues direction calls to `PENDING-SYNC.md`; a human resolves them later via `resolve-oq` / `sync`. Inputs are resolved deterministically from `.mega-sdd/vaults/company-profile-mini --auto` (`--vault=…`, `--code=…`, `--scope=…`) or the CWD; if a required input can't be resolved it emits a blocker (it never asks). Standalone interactive resolution was removed — drift resolution lives in `resolve-oq`/`sync`.

For revamp / extension projects (`mode=existing`), the vault is the target spec and the live codebase is current reality. They drift apart silently: a field renamed in code but not the vault, a flow step that violates a vault decision, an endpoint shipped without an ADR. This skill scans the codebase, compares it to the vault, and produces a structured drift report. Findings are heuristic (high recall, decent precision) — the report is a **starting point for review, not a verdict**.

> **Instruction language:** this skill reasons in English. Drift findings (entity names, paths, line numbers) are recorded verbatim from the codebase; rationale prose follows the vault's language.

## When to use

Trigger when the vault is `mode=existing` and the user wants to confirm the code still matches it: "drift detect", "vault vs code", "check codebase against vault", "cek code vs vault", "is the code in sync?". Also useful before locking a milestone, after a long sprint, or when onboarding a dev who needs "what's actually true vs documented".

Do NOT use when: the vault is `mode=new` (no live code to drift against — bail to `diff-vault`); the user wants vault evolution from a new PRD (that's `diff-vault`); or the codebase isn't readable.

## Core principle

> **The vault is one ground truth. The code is another. When they disagree, surface it — don't pick a side.**

Drift means either *code is right, vault is stale* (update vault) or *vault is right, code regressed* (fix code in a PR). The skill never assumes which. Findings are **direction-neutral**: "vault says X, code does Y, here's where each lives" — the user and their team decide the action.

## Drift outcome categories

| Category | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Missing in code** | Vault references an entity / flow / endpoint / decision with no analog in code. |
| **Missing in vault** | Code has an entity / flow / endpoint not documented in the vault. |
| **Name drift** | Same concept, different identifier (vault `failed_debit_count`, code `failed_attempts`). |
| **Type drift** | Same field name, different type / constraints (`int` vs `varchar`). |
| **Behavior drift** | Same flow ID, but code steps differ from the vault description. |
| **Decision violation** | Code violates a vault ADR (`D-XXX`). |
| **Decision unwritten** | Code embodies a decision not captured as an ADR. |
| **Confirmed match** | Vault says X, code does X. (Summarized, not detailed.) |

Each finding carries a **confidence**: `high` (exact name + type match / unambiguous absence), `medium` (similar names, different signatures), `low` (heuristic keyword guess — always verify manually).

Each finding also carries a **mutability-tier-aware severity**: **CRITICAL** (drift on a `kb_locked` regulatory/contractual claim — a compliance risk), **HIGH** (drift on a CONFIRMED claim, or a `kb_intent` claim whose outcome changed), **MEDIUM** (drift on `kb_intent` where implementation changed but outcome held), **LOW** (drift on `kb_artifact`, already flagged discardable). Vaults without `mutability_source` annotations → treat all drift as HIGH (safe default).

## Workflow

**Step 0 — Inputs (MANDATORY, deterministic — NEVER ask).** Resolve from `.mega-sdd/vaults/company-profile-mini --auto` first, then fall back; a fork cannot `AskUserQuestion`, so an unresolvable input emits a blocker, never a prompt:
- **`VAULT_DIR`** ← `--vault=<path>` arg, else auto-detect the CWD directory holding the standard vault files (layout-2: `vault.md` set; legacy: `00-index.md` …). Verify the lock `implementation_mode: existing` (vault.md frontmatter; legacy: 00-index.md Vault Lock Status) — if `new`, STOP per the hard rule below. Unresolvable → emit `drift_inputs_missing` (vault).
- **`CODE_DIR`** ← `--code=<path>` arg, else the CWD **only if it is obviously a repo** (`.git` or a manifest present). Otherwise do NOT guess — emit `drift_inputs_missing` (code). (When the orchestrator forks this skill it resolves and passes `--code`/`--vault` on the main thread, so the never-guess branch is reached only on a misseeded standalone run.)
- **`SCOPE_DIRS`** ← `--scope=<dirs|@file>` arg — the sync lane (`orchestrate-flow --sync`) passes `--scope=@<vault>/.sync-changed-paths.txt` (the already-resolved changed set — written by scan-codebase `--changed-only` on map-bearing projects or `scripts/derive-changed-paths.sh` on express-born ones; one repo-relative path per line). An `@`-prefixed value is READ as a path-list file; a bare value is a dir CSV or a `scope_metadata` id. Else full scan. Do NOT try to re-resolve the changed set from the dirty journal ∪ git delta on the sync lane: by the time this forked skill runs, scan-codebase has already consumed the journal (rotate-and-delete) and advanced `last_scanned_commit` to HEAD, so both channels are empty AND re-reading would race a concurrent journal consume (`2026-06-10-living-vault-continuous-sync-design.md §3.2/§3.7`). The scope file is read ONLY when `--scope=@<path>` explicitly points at it — never auto-discovered from the vault, so a leftover file can't silently scope a standalone run.

Log the scope explicitly — `Scope hint received: <scope.id|changed-paths(N)>` or `Full scan (no scope hint)`. Persist `VAULT_DIR`, `CODE_DIR`, `SCOPE_DIRS`. Run `git status` — note uncommitted changes in the report (findings reflect the working tree). The `drift_inputs_missing` blocker shape is in `references/auto-and-chain.md`.

**Step 0.5 — Drift scope (MANDATORY).** `full` (default) | `schema-only` (entities + constraints) | `flows-only` (flows + endpoints + jobs) | `decisions-only` (ADRs vs code) | `single-doc`. Persist `DRIFT_SCOPE`.

**Step 1 — Read vault** (by scope): `schema-only`→`model.md`; `flows-only`→`flows.md`+`vault.md ## Architecture`; `decisions-only`→`vault.md ## Decisions`; `full`→every vault doc. Build an internal model: entities (with field signatures), flow IDs (with steps), endpoints, ADRs (with constraints).

**Step 1.5 — Framework detection.** REUSE FIRST: when `.mega-sdd/codebase/codebase-map.md` exists with a §7 Framework block at confidence ≥ medium AND its `last_scanned_commit` matches git HEAD, adopt that framework verbatim (log `Framework from codebase-map §7: <name> (<confidence>)`) — don't re-parse manifests the scan already parsed. Map absent/stale/low-confidence → detect from manifest: `composer.json`→PHP (Laravel/Symfony), `package.json`→Node (Next/Nest/Express), `Gemfile`→Ruby, `go.mod`→Go, `requirements.txt`/`pyproject.toml`→Python, `pom.xml`/`build.gradle`→Java/Spring, `Cargo.toml`→Rust, `pubspec.yaml`→Flutter. Use the detected framework's default scope dirs (no confirmation — forked / non-interactive). Ambiguous (monorepo / multi-framework) → emit the `drift_framework_mismatch` blocker (see `references/auto-and-chain.md`) rather than asking which subproject.

**Step 2 — Scan codebase** with `Bash`/`Glob`/`Read`: entities (migrations, models/ORM defs → name + fields + types); flows/endpoints (routes, jobs/cron, controllers); decisions (parse each `D-XXX` constraint, keyword-probe the code — lowest confidence axis); OQ references (`OQ-{CODE}-{N}` in code/commits cross-referenced against still-open vault OQs).

**Step 3 — Compute drift.** Per axis, compare vault model vs code model. Each finding: category, vault reference (doc + section + identifier), code reference (path + line range), confidence, severity, suggested action (informational only).

**Step 4 — Write `DRIFT-REPORT.md`** to `<VAULT_DIR>/` (overwrite). Full report structure, section ordering (Decision findings PRIORITY-1 at top), and per-finding format are in **`references/report-format.md`**.

**Step 5 — Queue direction calls to `PENDING-SYNC.md` (ALWAYS — non-interactive).** Every finding that needs a human direction call is queued to `<vault>/PENDING-SYNC.md` (prioritized digest; appended by category) and the run continues — there is **no walkthrough and no `AskUserQuestion`**. A human resolves the queue later via `resolve-oq` / `sync`. With `--auto-apply=safe` (opt-in, deterministic — no question): the narrow safe class (confidence HIGH + category ∈ name-drift/type-drift/missing-in-vault + claim NOT `[LOCKED]` + code side committed) goes straight to the Step 5.5 write-back — everything else queues. Code-side actions (`FIX_CODE`) are NEVER executed by this skill. Template in `references/report-format.md`.

**Step 5.5 — Vault write-back (`--auto-apply=safe` ONLY; living-vault S5).** Write-back is **non-interactive** — there is no batch-diff ACCEPT prompt (a fork can't confirm). ONLY the narrow `--auto-apply=safe` class from Step 5 is written back: for each, DRAFT the exact vault patch with git provenance (`git log -1 --format='%h %s — %an, %ad' -- <code anchor file>` cited inline) and apply it. Everything outside the safe class stays queued in `PENDING-SYNC.md` for `resolve-oq`/`sync` — never auto-applied. Full protocol (per-category patch shapes, provenance line, the rails) → `references/report-format.md §Vault write-back protocol`.

**Step 6 — Update vault metadata.** No write-back applied → append a Changelog entry to the vault Changelog (vault.md; legacy: 00-index.md) recording the drift *session* only (version unchanged, `vault.json` untouched). Write-back applied (`--auto-apply=safe`, Step 5.5) → append the Changelog entry listing each patched section + provenance, bump the vault version (small bump vX.Y+1 — grammar per diff-vault's `references/diff-procedure.md`), and refresh `vault.json` by running `bash <plugin>/scripts/derive-vault-json.sh --vault <vault-dir>` (script-held lock; exit 4 → `memory_in_use` halt). Boundary rules → `references/report-format.md §Vault write-back protocol`.

**Step 7 — Self-check:** `mode=existing` confirmed; framework detected and scope dirs documented; every finding has category + vault ref + code ref + confidence; no silent "confirmed match"; decision findings at top; **every finding is queued to `PENDING-SYNC.md` (or auto-applied via `--auto-apply=safe`); NO `AskUserQuestion` was used**; no code changes executed; `DRIFT-REPORT.md` + `PENDING-SYNC.md` written.

**Step 8 — Present summary:** total findings + breakdown by category/confidence; top 3 PRIORITY-1 findings (one line each); path to the report; suggested next step. No "I have completed the scan…" preamble.

## Hard rules (the rails)

- **`mode=new` → STOP.** Surface `mode_migrate_after` if present; tell the user to flip to `existing` (or run `diff-vault` for PRD-vs-PRD). This rule holds even under `--auto`.
- **No code execution.** The skill writes report files only — it never modifies code, opens PRs, runs migrations. (Vault-side write-back happens ONLY for the deterministic `--auto-apply=safe` class; everything else is queued, never applied.) If asked to apply code fixes, it does not — the action stays in `PENDING-SYNC.md` for human follow-up.
- **Non-interactive (forked, `context: fork`).** NEVER calls `AskUserQuestion`. Inputs resolve from `.mega-sdd/vaults/company-profile-mini --auto`/CWD; an unresolvable required input emits a `drift_inputs_missing` blocker (never a prompt); direction calls queue to `PENDING-SYNC.md` for `resolve-oq`/`sync`. The standalone interactive walkthrough was removed in v3.0.0.
- **Direction-neutral framing.** Always present vault state and code state side-by-side; never declare one "wrong".
- **Confidence labels mandatory.** Low-confidence findings carry an explicit "verify manually" caveat.
- **No silent dismissal.** Confirmed matches are listed so reviewers know they were evaluated, not skipped.
- **Idempotency.** Re-running with no vault/code change regenerates an identical report.

## When to push back

**Always (as blockers / report notes — never prompts):** `mode=new` → STOP (`mode_migrate_after`); codebase path unresolvable → `drift_inputs_missing` (code); user asks the skill to apply code fixes → it doesn't (the action stays queued in `PENDING-SYNC.md`); major framework mismatch — vault implies one stack, manifest says another → emit `drift_framework_mismatch` (don't scan a possibly-wrong repo) rather than confirming.

**Conditional:** scope too large (>10k files) → recommend narrowing or per-subdirectory runs (warn that accuracy degrades, don't refuse); many low-confidence decision findings (>10) → recommend `decisions-only` with a narrower code scope; many unresolved OQs (>20 P1 open) → recommend `resolve-oq` first (drift against an unresolved vault is noisier).

## Limitations (be honest)

Heuristic detection, not static analysis — it greps and reads, no AST or type-checking, so false positives and negatives both happen. Semantic equivalence is hard (same concept, different name → flagged as Name drift for the user to confirm). Decision compliance is the lowest-confidence axis — treat violations as triggers for human review, not verdicts. Large monorepos degrade in time and accuracy — narrow scope. Not a replacement for code review or tests; it catches doc-vs-code divergence that neither typically checks.

## Specialist references (load on demand)

- **`references/report-format.md`** — the full `DRIFT-REPORT.md` template, section ordering, per-finding examples, the non-interactive vault write-back protocol, and the `vault.json` reconciliation boundary.
- **`references/constitution-drift.md`** — when `<vault>/constitution.md` exists, validate code against constitution clauses (§A–§F), the `constitution_drift_detected` halt, and the report's `## Constitution Findings` section.
- **`references/auto-and-chain.md`** — `--auto` behavior table, `drift_framework_mismatch` blocker YAML, handoff YAML emission, snapshot reuse, per-bolt incremental mode, suggested-next-actions block, and scope-aware scanning.

## Related skills

Vault must have `Implementation mode: existing`. OQ conventions + `vault.json` field rules: `generate-intent/references/vault-contract.md` (detect-drift reads `vault.json` but never writes it). Vault evolution from a new PRD: `diff-vault`. OQ resolution when drift produces new OQs: `resolve-oq`.

19	# Company Profile Mini — Grand Design
20	
21	> Situs profil publik sederhana: tiga halaman statis (Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak) dan satu form kontak yang menyimpan pesan ke database.
22	
23	Protokol baca vault (OQ, halt, istilah standar): `_meta/ai-consumer-guide.md`.
24	
25	## Phase context
26	
27	**Phase:** 1 of 1
28	
29	**Project type:** single-phase
30	
31	## Overview
32	
33	> **TL;DR**: Apa produknya, siapa penggunanya, apa yang di luar lingkup · PM, Architect, QA · baca pertama kali.
34	
35	### Product
36	
37	Halaman profil publik untuk sebuah unit kerja: siapa mereka, apa layanannya, dan cara menghubungi. Pengunjung membaca profil tanpa login dan bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak; pesan tersimpan di database.
38	
39	### Target users / personas
40	
41	- **Pengunjung**: membaca profil dan layanan, lalu mengirim pesan lewat form Kontak (PRD §Latar belakang, §Tujuan).
42	- **Admin**: membaca pesan yang masuk langsung dari database — tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini (PRD §Tujuan).
43	
44	### Problem
45	
46	Unit kerja belum punya halaman profil publik yang menjelaskan siapa mereka, layanannya, dan cara menghubungi mereka (PRD §Latar belakang).
47	
48	### Success criteria
49	
50	- Pengunjung membaca profil dan daftar layanan dalam satu kunjungan (PRD §Tujuan).
51	- Pengunjung bisa mengirim pesan lewat form kontak, dan pesannya tersimpan agar bisa dibaca admin lewat database (PRD §Tujuan).
52	
53	### Sources
54	
55	- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup
56	
57	### Out of Scope
58	
59	- Autentikasi, panel admin, notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
60	- UI admin untuk membaca pesan (PRD §Tujuan).
61	- Integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).
62	
63	## Architecture
64	
65	> **TL;DR**: Tiga halaman publik + satu handler kirim pesan + satu tabel · Architect, FE/BE Dev · baca sebelum menentukan route dan penyimpanan.
66	
67	### System overview
68	
69	Pengunjung membuka tiga halaman publik lewat browser. Konten Beranda dan Tentang Kami statis, diambil dari file konfigurasi. Form di Halaman Kontak dikirim ke server; server memvalidasi tiga field lalu menyimpan pesan ke tabel `contact_messages`. Admin membaca tabel itu langsung di database.
70	
71	```text
72	Pengunjung (browser)
73	  ├─ Beranda ──────── tombol ──▶ Kontak
74	  ├─ Tentang Kami ─── tautan ──▶ Beranda
75	  └─ Kontak ── kirim form ──▶ Server: validasi 3 field ──▶ contact_messages
76	                                                            ▲
77	                                   Admin (baca langsung di database)
78	```
79	
80	### Web Frontend
81	
82	| Component               | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                | Source                                 |
83	| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
84	| Halaman Beranda         | Judul organisasi, tagline satu kalimat, ringkasan tiga layanan utama (judul + satu paragraf per layanan), tombol menuju Halaman Kontak; responsif di 375px dan desktop | PRD §Halaman Beranda                   |
85	| Halaman Tentang Kami    | Profil singkat (dua–tiga paragraf statis), daftar tim (nama + peran, tanpa foto), tautan kembali ke Beranda                                                            | PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami              |
86	| Halaman Kontak          | Form nama/email/pesan; pesan sukses di halaman yang sama; error per field, isi form tidak hilang                                                                       | PRD §Halaman Kontak                    |
87	| File konfigurasi konten | Sumber konten statis (nama organisasi, layanan, tim); isi placeholder, diganti tim sendiri                                                                             | PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Open questions |
88	
89	**Tech stack (Web Frontend)**: tidak dinyatakan di PRD — dicatat sebagai OQ-AR-6 (resolved dari manifest repo).
90	
91	### Backend
92	
93	| Component                | Purpose                                                                            | Source                              |
94	| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
95	| Handler kirim pesan      | Validasi sisi server tiga field, simpan ke `contact_messages` beserta `created_at` | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |
96	| Tabel `contact_messages` | Menyimpan pesan pengunjung; dibaca admin langsung via database                     | PRD §Data model · §Tujuan           |
97	
98	Lokasi tabel (database upstream vs database baru di aplikasi) belum ditentukan PRD — OQ-AR-1.
99	
100	### Integrations
101	
102	Tidak ada integrasi eksternal di rilis ini (PRD §Latar belakang).
103	
104	### API contracts
105	
106	| Endpoint      | Method        | Purpose                                                                               | Auth                 | Errors                                                  | Source                              |
107	| ------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
108	| TBD — OQ-AR-2 | TBD — OQ-AR-2 | Terima `name`, `email`, `message`; validasi sisi server; simpan ke `contact_messages` | Tanpa login (publik) | Error validasi per field (`name` / `email` / `message`) | PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001 |
109	
110	### Sources
111	
112	- PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Halaman Kontak · §Data model · §Alur
113	
114	### Out of Scope
115	
116	- UI admin, panel admin, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup · §Tujuan).
117	- Foto anggota tim (PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami).
118	
119	## Decisions
120	
121	### D-001: Semua halaman publik tanpa login
122	
123	Situs ditujukan untuk pengunjung umum. **Decision**: Beranda, Tentang Kami, dan Kontak (termasuk kirim form) bisa diakses tanpa autentikasi. **Consequences**: tidak ada sesi pengguna; proteksi route aplikasi perlu pengecualian khusus untuk tiga halaman ini. **Source**: PRD §Latar belakang ("Tidak ada login") · §Ruang lingkup.
124	
125	### D-002: Konten statis dari file konfigurasi, bukan CMS
126	
127	Konten jarang berubah dan CMS di luar lingkup. **Decision**: nama organisasi, layanan, dan tim diambil dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri. **Consequences**: ubah konten = ubah file + deploy ulang. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Halaman Tentang Kami · §Ruang lingkup · §Open questions.
128	
129	### D-003: Validasi di server, hasil tampil di halaman yang sama
130	
131	**Decision**: form Kontak divalidasi di sisi server; valid → simpan ke `contact_messages` dan tampilkan "Pesan terkirim" di halaman yang sama; tidak valid → error per field dan isi form tetap. **Consequences**: aturan validasi berlaku di server, bukan hanya di browser. **Source**: PRD §Halaman Kontak · §Alur F-U-001.
132	
133	### D-004: Tidak ada UI admin di rilis ini
134	
135	**Decision**: admin membaca pesan langsung dari database. **Consequences**: tidak ada halaman daftar pesan, tidak ada notifikasi. **Source**: PRD §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup.
136

144	| OQ-AR-6 | Stack web dan test runner apa yang dipakai?                                            | tech / scan | high       | resolved at generation — `package.json:40` · `package.json:88` |
145	| OQ-FL-1 | Teks pesan error per field                                                             | business    | low        | needs review — conservative default                            |
146	| OQ-CN-1 | Proteksi spam form publik                                                              | business    | low        | needs review — conservative default                            |
147	| OQ-CN-3 | Syarat responsif untuk semua halaman                                                   | business    | low        | needs review — conservative default                            |
148	
149	### Auto-deferred (project_scale: xs)

152	- OQ-AR-2 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); alamat endpoint kirim form.
153	- OQ-AR-4 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); lokasi + format file konfigurasi konten.
154	- OQ-AR-5 → tech / recommend / medium — born `deferred` (`defer_to: binding`); URL tiga halaman.

7	---
8	
9	# Flows
10	
11	> **TL;DR**: Satu alur pengguna — kirim pesan kontak — dengan titik serah-terima browser ↔ server dan Definition of Done · FE/BE Dev, QA · baca saat membangun atau menguji form Kontak.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## User flows (web)
16	
17	### F-U-001: Kirim pesan kontak
18	
19	**Actor / Trigger**: Pengunjung, klik tombol Kirim di Halaman Kontak.
20	
21	**Flow**:
22	
23	```mermaid
24	flowchart TD
25	    subgraph BR["Browser"]
26	        S1["Pengunjung membuka Halaman Kontak"] --> S2["Isi nama, email, pesan lalu klik Kirim"]
27	        OK(["Tampilkan pesan sukses Pesan terkirim di halaman yang sama"])
28	        ERR(["Tampilkan error per field, isi form tetap terisi"])
29	    end
30	    subgraph SV["Server"]
31	        S3["Validasi tiga field"] --> D{"Semua field valid?"}
32	        D -- "ya" --> S4[("Simpan ke contact_messages beserta created_at")]
33	    end
34	    S2 -- "name, email, message" --> S3
35	    S4 -- "sukses" --> OK
36	    D -- "tidak: error per field" --> ERR
37	```
38	
39	**Aturan validasi (sisi server)**:
40	
41	| Field     | Aturan                        | Source              |
42	| --------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------- |
43	| `name`    | wajib, maksimal 100 karakter  | PRD §Halaman Kontak |
44	| `email`   | wajib, format email valid     | PRD §Halaman Kontak |
45	| `message` | wajib, maksimal 2000 karakter | PRD §Halaman Kontak |
46	
47	**Definition of Done**:
48	
49	- [ ] Pesan valid tersimpan dengan `created_at`.
50	- [ ] Email tidak valid ditolak dengan pesan error di field email.
51	- [ ] Form tetap terisi setelah gagal validasi.
52	- [ ] Setelah pesan valid tersimpan, teks "Pesan terkirim" tampil di halaman yang sama.
53	- [ ] Nama kosong atau lebih dari 100 karakter, dan pesan kosong atau lebih dari 2000 karakter, ditolak dengan error di field masing-masing.
54	
55	**Source**: PRD §Alur F-U-001 · §Halaman Kontak
56	
57	---
58	
59	## Sources
60	
61	- PRD §Alur F-U-001 · §Halaman Kontak
62	
63	## Out of Scope
64	
65	- Notifikasi email ke admin setelah pesan masuk (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
66	- Alur admin membaca/mengelola pesan di UI (PRD §Tujuan).
67

7	---
8	
9	# Constraints & Open Questions
10	
11	> **TL;DR**: Batasan teknis/bisnis, NFR, dan satu-satunya daftar Open Question vault ini · Architect, Tech Lead, PM · baca sebelum memilih solusi atau menguji rilis.
12	
13	## Technical constraints
14	
15	- **Akses**: tiga halaman dan form Kontak bisa dipakai tanpa login (PRD §Latar belakang · §Ruang lingkup).
16	- **Integrasi**: tidak ada integrasi eksternal (PRD §Latar belakang).
17	- **Konten**: konten statis dari file konfigurasi berisi placeholder; isi final diganti tim sendiri (PRD §Open questions).
18	- **Perangkat**: Beranda responsif di 375px dan desktop (PRD §Halaman Beranda). Cakupan halaman lain: OQ-CN-3.
19	
20	## Business constraints
21	
22	- **Ruang lingkup rilis**: tiga halaman publik + satu form (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
23	- **Admin**: membaca pesan langsung dari database; tidak ada UI admin (PRD §Tujuan).
24	- **Timeline / budget / regulasi**: tidak disebut di PRD.
25	
26	## Non-functional requirements
27	
28	| Category      | Requirement                                                                  | Source              |
29	| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
30	| Performance   | Halaman statis termuat < 2 detik di koneksi 3G                               | PRD §Non-functional |
31	| Accessibility | Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi                       | PRD §Non-functional |
32	| Security      | Input form di-escape saat ditampilkan; tidak ada HTML mentah dari pengunjung | PRD §Non-functional |
33	
34	## Design system
35	
36	### Accessibility
37	
38	- Semua field form berlabel; navigasi keyboard berfungsi (PRD §Non-functional — Aksesibilitas).
39	- Level WCAG: tidak disebut di PRD — tidak diasumsikan.
40	
41	---
42	
43	## Sources
44	
45	- PRD §Latar belakang · §Tujuan · §Ruang lingkup · §Halaman Beranda · §Non-functional · §Open questions
46	
47	## Out of Scope
48	
49	- Notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, CMS (PRD §Ruang lingkup).
50	- Target ketersediaan (uptime) dan skalabilitas — tidak disebut PRD, tidak diasumsikan.
51	
52	## Open Questions
53	
54	- [x] **OQ-AR-1** [P1] [tech / recommend] [conf: medium] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: Pesan dari form Kontak harus disimpan ke tabel `contact_messages`, tapi aplikasi ini belum punya database sendiri — semua datanya lewat API upstream (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`, dipakai `src/libs/api/server.ts:9`). Tabel itu tinggal di database mana: di layanan upstream (aplikasi hanya meneruskan lewat route proxy), atau database baru di dalam aplikasi ini? — resolve: binding (lihat Auto-Classification Review)
55	      → **Resolved v1.1** (2026-09-10): Tabel `contact_messages` ada di layanan upstream. Aplikasi ini hanya memvalidasi lalu meneruskan kiriman form ke API upstream lewat route proxy same-origin (`apiServer`); tidak ada database atau ORM baru di aplikasi ini. Rekomendasi binding diterima (ACCEPT) oleh runner benchmark sebagai pengganti stakeholder.
56	- [x] **OQ-AR-3** [P1] [tech / scan] [conf: high] [origin: vault.md#Decisions]: PRD meminta tiga halaman bisa dibuka tanpa login, padahal aplikasi ini mengarahkan semua pengunjung tanpa sesi ke `/login`. Di mana pengecualian untuk halaman publik diatur? — resolve: scan `src/proxy.ts`
57	      → Resolved v1.0: Pengecualian diatur di daftar `publicRoutes` pada `src/proxy.ts:11` (dicek di `src/proxy.ts:12`). Catatan: daftar yang sama juga dipakai untuk mengalihkan pengguna yang sudah login ke `/home` (`src/proxy.ts:24`) — cara pasti membuka tiga halaman ditentukan di binding.
58	- [x] **OQ-AR-2** [P2] [tech / recommend] [conf: medium] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: Form Kontak mengirim data ke server, tapi PRD tidak menyebut alamat endpoint-nya. Form dikirim ke alamat apa (method + path)? — resolve: binding (lihat Auto-Classification Review)
59	      → **Resolved v1.1** (2026-09-10): `POST /api/v1/contact-messages` di aplikasi (route proxy `src/app/api/v1/contact-messages/route.ts`), diteruskan ke upstream `POST /v1/contact-messages` mengikuti pola route users. Rekomendasi binding diterima (ACCEPT) oleh runner benchmark sebagai pengganti stakeholder.
60	- [x] **OQ-AR-4** [P2] [tech / recommend] [conf: medium] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: Konten statis (nama organisasi, layanan, tim) diambil dari "file konfigurasi", tapi PRD tidak menyebut lokasi dan formatnya — dan tidak eksplisit apakah tagline serta paragraf profil Tentang Kami ikut di file yang sama. File itu ditaruh di mana, formatnya apa, dan isinya apa saja? — resolve: binding (lihat Auto-Classification Review)
61	      → **Resolved v1.1** (2026-09-10): Satu modul TypeScript bertipe `src/configs/companyProfileConfig.ts` berisi nama organisasi, tagline, tiga layanan (judul + paragraf), paragraf profil Tentang Kami, dan daftar tim (nama + peran) — semuanya placeholder. Rekomendasi binding diterima (ACCEPT) oleh runner benchmark sebagai pengganti stakeholder.
62	- [x] **OQ-AR-5** [P2] [tech / recommend] [conf: medium] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: PRD tidak menyebut alamat URL tiga halaman, dan saat ini alamat `/` otomatis dialihkan ke dashboard `/home` (`next.config.ts:8`). Beranda, Tentang Kami, dan Kontak memakai URL apa? — resolve: binding (lihat Auto-Classification Review)
63	      → **Resolved v1.1** (2026-09-10): Beranda `/beranda`, Tentang Kami `/tentang-kami`, Kontak `/kontak`; pengalihan `/` → `/home` di `next.config.ts` tidak diubah. Rekomendasi binding diterima (ACCEPT) oleh runner benchmark sebagai pengganti stakeholder.
64	- [x] **OQ-AR-6** [P2] [tech / scan] [conf: high] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: PRD tidak menyebut teknologi. Stack web dan test framework apa yang dipakai aplikasi ini? — resolve: scan manifest `package.json`
65	      → Resolved v1.0: Next.js 16 (`package.json:40`), form react-hook-form + zod (`package.json:48`, `package.json:52`), test Vitest (`package.json:88`) + React Testing Library (`package.json:61`) + MSW (`package.json:75`).
66	- [ ] **OQ-FL-2** [P2] [business] [conf: high] [origin: flows.md#F-U-001]: Alur Kirim Pesan hanya membahas dua hasil: data valid (tersimpan) dan data tidak valid (error per field). Kalau data sudah valid tapi penyimpanannya gagal (misalnya server atau database sedang bermasalah), apa yang dilihat pengunjung, dan apakah isi form tetap dipertahankan? — resolve: PO
67	- [ ] **OQ-FL-1** [P3] [business] [conf: low] [origin: flows.md#F-U-001]: PRD meminta error ditampilkan per field, tapi tidak memberi teksnya. Kalimat error apa yang ditampilkan untuk nama kosong/terlalu panjang, email tidak valid, dan pesan kosong/terlalu panjang? — resolve: PO
68	- [ ] **OQ-CN-1** [P3] [business] [conf: low]: Form Kontak publik dan tanpa login, jadi siapa pun bisa mengirim pesan berulang kali. Apakah perlu pembatasan (misalnya batas jumlah kiriman atau captcha), atau cukup tanpa proteksi di rilis ini? — resolve: PO
69	- [ ] **OQ-CN-2** [P3] [business] [conf: high]: Form menyimpan nama dan email pengunjung (data pribadi). Berapa lama pesan disimpan, dan apakah perlu persetujuan pengunjung atau ketentuan compliance lain sebelum data disimpan? — resolve: PO / compliance
70	- [ ] **OQ-CN-3** [P3] [business] [conf: low] [origin: vault.md#Architecture]: Syarat "responsif di 375px dan desktop" hanya tertulis di bagian Halaman Beranda. Apakah syarat ini juga berlaku untuk Halaman Tentang Kami dan Halaman Kontak? — resolve: PO
71

2	
3	**Status**: Active
4	**Version**: 1.0
5	**Last reviewed**: 2026-09-10
6	**Sign-off**: TBD - confirm with PO / Tech Lead (review sebelum bolts dimulai)

9	
10	---
11	
12	## §A. Coding standards (Non-negotiable)
13	
14	- A-001: Form memakai react-hook-form + zod lewat `zodResolver`; skema zod beserta tipe dan nilai default ditaruh di `src/features/<feature>/schemas/` (source: CLAUDE.md §Forms).
15	- A-002: Test memakai Vitest + React Testing Library + MSW; modul yang punya test ditaruh sebagai folder `foo/index.ts` + `foo/index.test.ts` (source: CLAUDE.md §Stack & Commands).
16	- A-003: Setiap field form punya label, dan seluruh form bisa dipakai lewat keyboard (source: PRD §Non-functional — Aksesibilitas).
17	
18	## §B. Security baselines
19	
20	- B-001: Ketiga field divalidasi di sisi server sebelum disimpan — `name` wajib ≤100 karakter, `email` wajib format valid, `message` wajib ≤2000 karakter; validasi di browser saja tidak cukup (source: PRD §Halaman Kontak).
21	- B-002: Input pengunjung di-escape saat ditampilkan; tidak ada HTML mentah dari pengunjung yang dirender (source: PRD §Non-functional — Keamanan).
22	- B-003: Tidak ada secret di kode; konfigurasi lewat env (`.env.local`, tidak di-commit) (source: CLAUDE.md §Env vars).
23	- B-004: Yang dibuka tanpa login hanya tiga halaman PRD (Beranda, Tentang Kami, Kontak) dan endpoint kirim pesannya; proteksi route lain tidak dilonggarkan (source: PRD §Ruang lingkup · src/proxy.ts:11).
24	
25	## §C. Architecture invariants
26	
27	- C-001: Konten statis (nama organisasi, layanan, tim) dibaca dari file konfigurasi, bukan dari database atau CMS (source: PRD §Halaman Beranda · §Open questions).
28	- C-002: Browser tidak memanggil API upstream secara langsung; panggilan dari browser lewat route proxy same-origin `/api/v1/*` yang dibuat dengan factory `proxyGet/proxyPost/proxyPut/proxyDelete` (source: CLAUDE.md §Next.js API routes are thin proxies · src/libs/api/route-handler.ts:43).
29	
30	## §D. Anti-patterns
31	
32	- D-001: JANGAN menambah autentikasi, panel admin, notifikasi email, multi-bahasa, atau CMS di rilis ini (source: PRD §Ruang lingkup).
33	- D-002: JANGAN menampilkan foto anggota tim (source: PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami).
34	
35	## §E. Performance constraints
36	
37	- E-001: Halaman statis termuat < 2 detik di koneksi 3G (source: PRD §Non-functional — Performa).
38	
39	## §F. Compliance
40	
41	Tidak ada klausul — PRD tidak menyebut kewajiban regulasi. Pertanyaan retensi data pribadi dicatat sebagai OQ-CN-2 di `constraints.md`.
